B000BVZYYA.en: A black walking shoe with a smooth, slightly shiny upper, textured side panels, and small perforations. Two wide hook-and-loop straps cross the top, above a thick black sole with a ridged edge and tread.
B000BVZYYA.zh: 一款黑色步行鞋，鞋面光滑并略带光泽，侧面有纹理拼片和小孔。鞋面有两条宽大的粘扣带，搭配厚实的黑色鞋底，边缘带有凹槽，底面有纹路。

B000AS5GH4.en: A black slip-on slipper has a rounded, closed toe and a suede-like upper, with tan lining visible around the opening. It has no fastening, and a thick black sole with a ridged edge.
B000AS5GH4.zh: 这是一只黑色套穿式拖鞋，圆头封闭，鞋面看起来像麂皮，鞋口露出棕褐色内衬。它没有扣合装置，配有厚实的黑色鞋底，边缘带有凹凸纹。

B000AS5GLK.en: This is a dark brown, closed-toe slipper with a soft-looking suede-like upper and a wide cream-colored fuzzy cuff. It has no visible fastener, and the dark rubber sole is thick, ridged, and slightly raised around the edge.
B000AS5GLK.zh: 这是一只深棕色包头拖鞋，鞋面看起来像柔软的麂皮，鞋口有宽大的奶油色绒毛翻边。看不到明显的扣合装置；深色橡胶鞋底较厚，带有纹路，边缘略微凸起。

B000ARKMQA.en: A white low-top sneaker with a smooth-looking synthetic upper, mesh-like fabric around the collar, and white laces threaded through shiny metal loops. It has a thick white sole with a ridged, deeply treaded outsole and a small gray detail at the heel.
B000ARKMQA.zh: 这是一双白色低帮运动鞋，鞋面看起来是光滑的合成材料，鞋口周围有网状织物，白色鞋带穿过亮面的金属鞋眼。鞋底厚实，白色外底带有明显的沟纹和深齿纹，后跟处有一小块灰色细节。

B000BO5F9Q.en: A black athletic walking shoe has a smooth, leather-like upper with small perforations and stitched panels. It fastens with black laces, and has a thick black sole with molded grooves and a ridged toe edge.
B000BO5F9Q.zh: 这是一只黑色运动步行鞋，鞋面看起来光滑，类似皮革，带有小孔和拼接线条。鞋带为黑色；厚实的黑色鞋底带有模压凹槽，鞋头边缘有纹路。

B000ARJGC6.en: A dark gray lace-up sneaker has a mixed-material upper, with smooth panels, stitched sections, and mesh-like fabric around the tongue and collar. Brown laces run through fabric loops, and a thick, sculpted light-gray midsole sits above a chunky black treaded outsole.
B000ARJGC6.zh: 这是一只深灰色系带运动鞋，鞋面由多种材质组成，有光滑拼片、缝线区域，以及鞋舌和鞋口处类似网布的织物。棕色鞋带穿过织物鞋环，厚实的浅灰色中底下方是凹凸明显的黑色外底。

B000AS7F9G.en: A black slip-on clog slipper with a closed toe and an open back. The upper looks like soft, matte fabric with a small label at the side; a dark rubber-like sole has a ridged tread and stitched-looking edge detail.
B000AS7F9G.zh: 这是一只黑色套脚式木屐拖鞋，鞋头包覆、后跟敞开。鞋面看起来是柔软的哑光织物，侧面有一小块标签；深色鞋底像橡胶，底面带有纹路，边缘有类似缝线的细节。

B000ARGWZA.en: This is a black, low-cut slip-on sneaker with a smooth synthetic-looking upper and a ribbed fabric collar. It has no laces; shiny oval eyelets decorate the sides, and a thick black sole has deep, chunky tread.
B000ARGWZA.zh: 这是一只黑色低帮套穿运动鞋，鞋面看起来光滑，像合成材料，鞋口为罗纹织物。鞋上没有鞋带，鞋侧饰有亮面的椭圆形孔眼；厚实的黑色鞋底带有深而粗大的纹路。

B000EY5ORQ.en: A black leather-looking Oxford has a smooth rounded toe and stitched panels along the sides. It fastens with black laces and has a thick black sole with a low block heel and ridged sides.
B000EY5ORQ.zh: 这是一双黑色、外观似皮革的牛津鞋，鞋头圆润光滑，侧面有拼接缝线。鞋带为黑色，鞋底较厚，带有低矮的方跟和带纹路的侧面。

B000DZXYTQ.en: A brown flip-flop has a textured footbed and dark brown fabric straps with a small green tag. The straps pass between the toes, and the sole is a thick, curved brown layer with a thin light-colored stripe around the edge.
B000DZXYTQ.zh: 这是一只棕色人字拖，鞋床带有纹理，深棕色布质鞋带上有一枚小绿标。鞋带从脚趾间穿过，鞋底厚实并略带弧度，边缘有一道浅色细条。

B000H100IE.en: A dark navy clog slipper has a smooth, suede-like upper and a fluffy navy lining around the opening. It slips on without a visible fastening, and has a thick dark gray sole with deep, blocky tread.
B000H100IE.zh: 这是一只深藏青色的包头拖鞋，鞋面看起来像光滑的麂皮，鞋口围着蓬松的藏青色绒毛。它没有可见的扣合装置，配有厚实的深灰色鞋底和深而粗犷的块状纹路。

B000EDTVYY.en: A gray-and-black strappy sport sandal with a molded gray toe guard and open sides. The upper looks like woven fabric straps, with a lace-and-toggle closure and a heel strap; the thick gray rubber sole has a dark, patterned tread.
B000EDTVYY.zh: 这是一款灰黑相间的带条运动凉鞋，带有模压灰色护趾和开放式侧面。鞋面看起来由编织织物带构成，以系带和扣件收紧，并有后跟带；厚实的灰色橡胶鞋底带有深色纹路。

B000HDNWFK.en: A black, closed-toe clog sandal has a smooth-looking upper and a wide strap with a metal buckle across the top. Its thick black sole has a ridged edge, with a tan footbed visible at the heel.
B000HDNWFK.zh: 这是一款黑色包头木屐凉鞋，鞋面看起来光滑，鞋面上有一条宽带，并配有金属扣。黑色厚鞋底边缘呈纹路状，后跟处可见棕褐色鞋床。

B000Q941ZU.en: A white lace-up athletic shoe with a smooth, leather-like upper, stitched panels, and small perforations along the sides. It has a thick white sole with curved ridges and a rounded toe.
B000Q941ZU.zh: 这是一只白色系带运动鞋，鞋面看起来光滑、类似皮革，并带有拼接缝线和侧面的小透气孔。它配有厚实的白色鞋底，鞋底带弧形纹路，鞋头圆润。

B000M25WV8.en: A slip-on slipper with a gray and black plaid upper that looks like woven fabric, and a fluffy light-gray lining around the opening. It has no visible fastener and a low, dark-gray sole with a slightly raised edge.
B000M25WV8.zh: 这是一只套穿式拖鞋，鞋面呈灰黑格纹，看起来像织物，鞋口包有蓬松的浅灰色绒里。没有可见的扣合装置，鞋底较薄，呈深灰色，边缘略微凸起。

B000OYQOCK.en: This is a low-cut slip-on shoe in muted brown, with a canvas-like fabric upper and a wide tongue over the instep. It has no visible laces or buckle, and a flat tan midsole above a thin dark outsole.
B000OYQOCK.zh: 这是一只低帮套穿鞋，呈暗棕色，鞋面看起来像帆布，宽鞋舌覆盖脚背。鞋面没有可见的鞋带或搭扣；平坦的棕褐色中底下方是一层较薄的深色外底。

B000VQFLPW.en: A brown ankle-high hiking boot has a textured olive-brown fabric upper with darker brown leather-like panels. It fastens with dark laces through metal hooks and eyelets, and has a thick black, deeply treaded sole.
B000VQFLPW.zh: 这是一只棕色的中帮登山靴，鞋面为橄榄棕色的纹理织物，并拼有较深的棕色皮革状面料。鞋带穿过金属挂钩和鞋眼系紧，底部是厚实、带深纹路的黑色鞋底。

B0012G6KX2.en: A chunky low-top sneaker in black with purple accents and gray patterned panels. The upper looks like a mix of smooth and textured synthetic material, with white laces; the thick white sole has sculpted ridges and black tread sections.
B0012G6KX2.zh: 这是一款厚底低帮运动鞋，以黑色为主，带有紫色点缀和灰色花纹拼片。鞋面看起来由光滑与纹理感的人造材料拼接而成，配有白色鞋带；厚白色鞋底带有立体凹槽和黑色鞋底纹路。

B0017H5ECE.en: A white slip-on sneaker with a smooth leather-looking upper and a small blue logo near the heel. It has no visible laces or fastener, and a thick white rubber sole with fine ridges along the edge.
B0017H5ECE.zh: 这是一款白色一脚蹬运动鞋，鞋面看起来光滑似皮革，后跟附近有一个蓝色小标志。鞋面没有可见的鞋带或其他扣合装置，配有厚实的白色橡胶鞋底，边缘带细纹。

B0012HT9AM.en: A white lace-up walking shoe with a smooth, stitched upper and a padded mesh tongue and collar. It has a thick white sole with molded grooves and dark gray tread along the bottom.
B0012HT9AM.zh: 这是一只白色系带步行鞋，鞋面光滑并带有缝线，鞋舌和鞋口为填充网布。厚实的白色鞋底带有模压纹路，底部边缘可见深灰色鞋纹。

B001AOI2T6.en: A brown slip-on slipper has a suede-like upper and a fluffy cream-colored lining around the opening. It has no visible fastening, and a thick gray sole with a textured edge.
B001AOI2T6.zh: 这是一只棕色套穿式拖鞋，鞋面看起来像麂皮，鞋口露出蓬松的奶油色绒里。没有可见的扣合装置，厚实的灰色鞋底边缘带有纹理。

B0012HR2I8.en: A black walking shoe with a textured leather-like upper, stitched panels, and black laces. It has a thick black rubber sole with molded grooves and tread.
B0012HR2I8.zh: 这是一只黑色步行鞋，鞋面呈皮革质感，有缝线拼接，并以黑色鞋带系紧。鞋底为厚实的黑色橡胶，带有模压沟槽和纹路。

B001EJMRKW.en: A closed-toe clog with a tan upper covered in dark brown and black leopard spots. It has a broad instep strap with no visible buckle, and a thick tan sole with a low heel and stitched detailing.
B001EJMRKW.zh: 这是一只包头木屐鞋，棕褐色鞋面布满深棕色和黑色的豹纹斑点。鞋背有一条宽带，没有可见的搭扣；厚实的棕褐色鞋底带低跟和缝线装饰。

B0017L7ZR2.en: A gray closed-toe sport sandal with open sides, smooth-looking synthetic straps, and multicolored striped fabric panels across the top. It fastens with adjustable straps and a cord-and-toggle closure; the thick, sculpted light-gray sole has brown tread sections and a small purple accent.
B0017L7ZR2.zh: 这是一款灰色包头运动凉鞋，鞋身两侧敞开，带有表面光滑的合成材质绑带和鞋面上的彩色条纹织物拼片。鞋子通过可调节绑带和带扣绳收紧；厚实的浅灰色立体鞋底带有棕色纹路部分和一小块紫色点缀。

B001BFFTO0.en: A reddish-brown leather lace-up ankle boot with metal eyelets and visible contrast stitching. It has a thick, dark, lugged rubber sole.
B001BFFTO0.zh: 这是一双红棕色皮革系带短靴，配有金属鞋眼和清晰可见的撞色缝线。鞋底厚实、深色，带有粗齿纹。

B001D4NA5O.en: A dark brown, closed-toe slip-on slipper has a soft-looking suede-like upper, with a stitched seam across the top and elastic panels at the sides of the opening. Its dark rubber-looking sole is low and slightly raised around the edge.
B001D4NA5O.zh: 这是一只深棕色的包头套穿式拖鞋，鞋面看起来像柔软的麂皮，鞋面上有缝线，鞋口两侧有松紧布料。深色鞋底看起来像橡胶，较低，边缘略微向上包起。

B001OQBN96.en: A black wedge sandal has several textured, crisscrossing straps across the toe and instep, with an open toe and no visible buckle or other fastener. Its black sole rises into a solid, sloping wedge heel, and the footbed has molded ridges.
B001OQBN96.zh: 这是一款黑色坡跟凉鞋，鞋头和脚背处有几条交错的纹理鞋带，鞋头敞开，看不到搭扣或其他固定装置。黑色鞋底向后抬高，形成实心斜坡鞋跟，鞋床上有凸起纹路。

B0023RRTWU.en: A low-top sneaker has a white rubber toe cap and a brightly striped fabric upper in pink, red, orange, green, blue, and purple. It fastens with white laces, and the white rubber sole has a black stripe along the side.
B0023RRTWU.zh: 这是一款低帮运动鞋，白色橡胶鞋头搭配粉、红、橙、绿、蓝和紫色条纹布面。鞋带为白色，白色橡胶鞋底侧边有一道黑色条纹。

B001PTHG1Q.en: This is a black flip-flop sandal with a black fabric-looking thong strap patterned with thin white lines and small logos. The strap passes between the toes, and the sandal has a thick, dark sole with a light-colored treaded edge.
B001PTHG1Q.zh: 这是一只黑色人字拖，黑色织物质感的夹趾带上有细白线图案和小标志。夹趾带从脚趾间穿过，鞋底较厚、颜色较深，边缘露出浅色的纹路底面。

B0026MRNGO.en: A gray suede moccasin has a rounded toe with a fringed flap and visible stitching around the front. A suede lace ties in a bow across the top, and a thin black sole runs underneath.
B0026MRNGO.zh: 这是一只灰色麂皮莫卡辛鞋，圆鞋头上有带流苏的翻片，前部可见缝线。鞋面上的麂皮鞋带系成蝴蝶结，底部是一圈黑色薄鞋底。

B002CO3LM6.en: A black dance shoe with a rounded toe, low-cut vamp, and chunky heel. Its smooth-looking upper has a narrow strap across the instep with a small metal buckle; the thin sole has a dark edge and a brown-toned bottom visible at the toe.
B002CO3LM6.zh: 这是一只黑色舞鞋，圆头、低口鞋面，配有粗跟。鞋面看起来光滑，脚背处有一条细带，并以小金属搭扣固定；薄鞋底边缘呈深色，鞋头处可见棕色底面。

B0026MRR1A.en: A dark brown moccasin-style shoe has a pebbled leather-looking upper with stitched edging around the toe and a leather lace tied across the top. It has a low, dark rubber sole with fine ridges along the bottom edge.
B0026MRR1A.zh: 这是一只深棕色莫卡辛式鞋，鞋面看起来有颗粒纹理，鞋头边缘缝线明显，鞋面上系着一条皮质鞋带。鞋底较低，呈深色橡胶质感，底边带有细纹。

B0026MRQMU.en: A brown moccasin slipper has a suede-like upper, with cream fleece lining visible around the opening. A tan leather lace ties across the vamp, and the flat tan sole has a fine ridged edge.
B0026MRQMU.zh: 这是一只棕色莫卡辛拖鞋，鞋面呈绒面质感，鞋口露出奶油色绒毛内里。鞋面系有一条棕褐色皮质鞋带，平坦的棕褐色鞋底边缘带有细密纹路。

B002CO2WSK.en: A black slip-on jazz shoe with a smooth, slightly shiny leather-like upper and a stretchy fabric panel across the side. It has no laces or buckle, and a thin black sole with a low heel.
B002CO2WSK.zh: 这是一只黑色套穿式爵士舞鞋，鞋面光滑，略带光泽，看起来像皮革，侧面有一块弹性布料拼片。鞋上没有鞋带或搭扣，配有黑色薄鞋底和低鞋跟。

B002COHZ3M.en: A black dance sneaker has a textured mesh upper with smooth black overlays and black laces. Its thick black sole has a rounded toe and a visibly segmented, curved heel.
B002COHZ3M.zh: 这是一只黑色舞蹈运动鞋，鞋面为纹理网布，并带有光滑的黑色拼接层和黑色鞋带。厚实的黑色鞋底鞋头圆润，后跟呈明显分段的弧形。

B002CQTY84.en: A white ballet slipper with a smooth, fabric-looking upper and thin white elastic ties crossing over the top. The flat sole is a small, separate-looking piece beneath the front of the shoe, with the rest of the bottom appearing white.
B002CQTY84.zh: 这是一只白色芭蕾舞鞋，鞋面光滑，外观看起来像布料，鞋面上有细白色松紧带交叉系合。鞋底平坦，鞋头下方可见一小块独立的底片，其余鞋底看起来也是白色。

B002CQTZH4.en: A dark gray moccasin-style slipper with a suede-like upper and a short lace threaded through the top. It has a thick, dark rubber sole with fine vertical ridges around the sides.
B002CQTZH4.zh: 这是一只深灰色莫卡辛式拖鞋，鞋面看起来像麂皮，顶部穿有一根短鞋带。鞋底厚实、颜色较深，侧边有细密的竖向纹路。

B002KKCZLA.en: A dark brown and charcoal sport sandal with an open toe and heel. Its upper has textured fabric straps with brown edging and orange lettering, fastened by adjustable hook-and-loop straps. The thick dark rubber sole has a rugged, deeply treaded bottom.
B002KKCZLA.zh: 这是一款深棕色和炭灰色的运动凉鞋，露趾且后跟敞开。鞋面由带纹理的织物鞋带构成，边缘为棕色，并饰有橙色字样；鞋带以可调节的粘扣带固定。厚实的深色橡胶鞋底带有粗犷、深刻的纹路。

B002GJTKTA.en: A tall rain boot with a black-and-white herringbone-patterned textile-looking upper and black trim. A black strap with a silver-tone buckle wraps around the top; the black sole is thick and ridged underneath.
B002GJTKTA.zh: 一款高筒雨靴，鞋面呈黑白人字纹，外观看起来像织物材质，边缘饰有黑色包边。黑色带子绕过靴筒顶部，并以银色搭扣固定；黑色鞋底较厚，底面有纹路。

B002OHE3DC.en: A black leather-looking Oxford dress shoe with a rounded toe and stitched panels. It fastens with black laces, and has a thick black sole with a low block heel.
B002OHE3DC.zh: 这是一只黑色、外观似皮革的牛津正装鞋，圆头并带有拼接缝线。鞋带为黑色，鞋底较厚，后跟是低矮的方跟。

B002OHE4I6.en: A brown leather boat shoe with moc-toe stitching and darker brown panels around the sides. Brown laces pass through metal eyelets along the sides, and a low, flat taupe-brown rubber sole runs beneath it.
B002OHE4I6.zh: 这是一只棕色皮革船鞋，鞋头有莫克缝线，鞋身侧面拼接着较深棕色的部分。棕色鞋带穿过两侧的金属鞋眼，底部是一圈低矮、平坦的灰棕色橡胶鞋底。

B002JVWOO8.en: A gray mid-cut hiking boot with a black toe cap and dark trim. The upper looks like a mix of suede-like and mesh fabric, with black-and-yellow laces threaded through metal eyelets and hooks. It has a thick, black, deeply treaded rubber sole.
B002JVWOO8.zh: 这是一只灰色中帮登山靴，鞋头包有黑色护边，整体带有深色饰边。鞋面看起来由绒面质感材料和网布拼接而成，黑黄相间的鞋带穿过金属鞋眼和挂钩。鞋底厚实、呈黑色，底纹较深。

B002OHE4JK.en: A brown plain-toe Oxford has a smooth, slightly pebbled upper with stitched panels and brown laces. It has a thick black sole with a low heel and a ridged tread.
B002OHE4JK.zh: 这是一款棕色圆头牛津鞋，鞋面光滑并带有细微颗粒纹理，拼接处有缝线，鞋带也是棕色的。鞋底厚实、呈黑色，带低跟和纹路。

B002P66J20.en: A black slip-on shoe with a smooth leather-like upper, tan contrast stitching, and a round decorative button beside the opening. It has no visible laces or buckle, and a thick black sole with a low heel and ridged edge.
B002P66J20.zh: 这是一只黑色套脚鞋，鞋面看起来像光滑皮革，配有棕褐色对比缝线，鞋口旁有一颗圆形装饰扣。没有可见的鞋带或搭扣，鞋底较厚、呈黑色，带低跟和纹路边缘。

B002OHE4D6.en: A black slip-on dress loafer with a smooth leather-looking upper, stitched seams, and a raised band across the instep. It has no laces or buckle, and a thick black sole with a low block heel.
B002OHE4D6.zh: 这是一款黑色套脚正装乐福鞋，鞋面看起来光滑似皮革，带有缝线和横跨脚背的凸起饰带。鞋面没有鞋带或搭扣，配有厚实的黑色鞋底和低矮的方跟。

B002QB1ELK.en: A black moccasin-style slipper with a fuzzy, suede-like upper and a red-and-black plaid lining. It has a tan leather lace tied across the front, and a thick, flat tan sole with visible stitching around the edge.
B002QB1ELK.zh: 这是一只黑色莫卡辛式拖鞋，鞋面看起来毛茸茸的，像麂皮，内衬为红黑格纹。鞋头系着一根棕褐色皮绳，鞋底厚而平，边缘可见缝线。

B0033WST6E.en: A closed-toe Mary Jane shoe with a black upper covered in a glossy, multicoloured mosaic-like pattern. It has a strap across the instep with a round silver buckle, and a thick black platform sole with white stitching.
B0033WST6E.zh: 这是一款包头玛丽珍鞋，黑色鞋面带有闪亮的多色马赛克状图案。鞋面有一条横跨脚背的搭带，配圆形银色搭扣；厚实的黑色厚底边缘缝有白线。

B002VPE1RU.en: A reddish-brown boat shoe with a smooth, leather-like upper and visible white stitching around the toe. It fastens with pale laces through metal eyelets, and has a low, light-colored sole with a thin darker strip above it.
B002VPE1RU.zh: 这是一只红棕色船鞋，鞋面光滑，呈皮革质感，鞋头周围有明显的白色缝线。浅色鞋带穿过金属鞋眼固定，鞋底较低、颜色较浅，上方有一圈深色细边。

B003LN0HG0.en: This is a thong sandal with a pale gold, textured upper and a wide strap featuring a gold-tone buckle. The straps meet between the toes, and the sandal has a dark brown footbed with a thick, dark brown sole and a cork-colored band above it.
B003LN0HG0.zh: 这是一双夹趾凉鞋，鞋面为浅金色纹理材质，并有一条饰以金色搭扣的宽带。鞋带在脚趾间相连，深棕色鞋床下方是厚实的深棕色鞋底，边缘带有软木色饰层。

B003KTM9CA.en: A tan boat shoe with a smooth leather-looking toe and heel, textured beige fabric panels, and white stitching. It has tan laces threaded through metal eyelets, and a low, pale beige rubber sole with a shallow ridged edge.
B003KTM9CA.zh: 这是一只棕褐色船鞋，鞋头和后跟看起来是光滑皮革，鞋身侧面为米色纹理织物，并带有白色缝线。棕褐色鞋带穿过金属鞋眼，搭配低矮的浅米色橡胶鞋底，鞋底边缘有浅纹路。

B003M68UN8.en: A lace-up athletic sneaker with a dark navy and black upper, gray mesh panels, and white laces. The upper combines mesh with smooth-looking overlays, and the thick white sole has black tread and dark cutout details.
B003M68UN8.zh: 这是一款系带运动鞋，鞋面以深海军蓝和黑色为主，配有灰色网布和白色鞋带。鞋面由网布和光滑外观的拼接层组成，厚实的白色鞋底带有黑色纹路和深色镂空细节。

B003O2SLXY.en: A black closed-toe sandal with a textured rubber toe guard and wide webbing straps over the upper. It fastens with elastic laces and a cord lock; the thick black sole has deep tread and a raised toe guard.
B003O2SLXY.zh: 这是一款黑色包头凉鞋，鞋头有纹理橡胶护边，鞋面覆有宽织带。它以弹力鞋带和锁扣固定；厚实的黑色鞋底带有较深的纹路，鞋头向上包覆。

B003O2SLCA.en: A black slip-on slipper has a quilted fabric upper, a rounded reinforced toe, and a soft-looking dark lining around the opening. It has no visible fastening, and a thick, black, textured rubber-like sole that wraps up around the toe and sides.
B003O2SLCA.zh: 这是一只黑色套穿式便鞋，鞋面为绗缝织物，圆头带有加固包边，鞋口露出深色绒面内衬。看不到明显的扣合装置；厚实的黑色纹理鞋底向上包住鞋头和两侧。

B003YBQ2E0.en: A bright pink, open-toe flat with a one-piece molded upper patterned with circular cutouts. It has no visible fastening, and the low pink sole has a lightly textured tread.
B003YBQ2E0.zh: 这是一只亮粉色露趾平底鞋，一体成型的鞋面带有圆形镂空图案。看不到搭扣等固定装置，低矮的粉色鞋底带有轻微纹路。

B00413QUHE.en: A white and light-gray walking shoe with a mostly synthetic-looking upper, perforated panels, and stitched overlays. It fastens with white laces, and has a thick, sculpted white midsole with gray and teal sections along the dark-gray outsole.
B00413QUHE.zh: 这是一双白色和浅灰色的步行鞋，鞋面看起来以合成材料为主，带有透气孔和拼接缝线。鞋带为白色；厚实、带有曲线造型的白色中底下方，可见灰色和蓝绿色的外底部分。

B003OYJ7CQ.en: A black and purple running shoe with a mesh upper, pale mint-green panels, and purple crisscrossing overlays. It fastens with purple laces; the thick sole is pale mint green with wavy purple and white sections underneath.
B003OYJ7CQ.zh: 这是一只黑色和紫色的跑鞋，网布鞋面配有浅薄荷绿面板和交错的紫色覆层。鞋带为紫色；厚鞋底以浅薄荷绿色为主，底部带有波浪状的紫色和白色部分。

B003UHUM5S.en: A pale cream walking shoe with a smooth, leather-like upper and stitched overlays, plus a large outlined side logo. Two broad hook-and-loop straps fasten across the top, above a thick cream sole with shallow grooves and a low heel.
B003UHUM5S.zh: 这是一只浅奶油色的步行鞋，鞋面看起来光滑似皮革，并带有缝线拼接，侧面有醒目的镂空轮廓标志。鞋面由两条宽大的粘扣带固定，下方是厚实的奶油色鞋底，带有浅槽和低跟。

B0041FHZAS.en: A low-cut hiking-style shoe in olive and charcoal, with a textured fabric-and-synthetic-looking upper and orange-brown accents. It fastens with dark laces through fabric loops and eyelets, and has a thick black sole with deep, chunky tread.
B0041FHZAS.zh: 这是一只低帮徒步风格的鞋，呈橄榄绿和炭灰色，鞋面看起来由有纹理的织物和合成材料制成，并带有橙棕色细节。鞋带穿过织物环和鞋眼系紧，厚实的黑色鞋底带有深而粗犷的纹路。

B004EIHD18.en: A black thong sandal has a broad strap across the top with a metal buckle at the side. The upper looks smooth and matte, and the tan footbed sits above a mottled brown cork-like midsole and a black ridged outsole.
B004EIHD18.zh: 这是一只黑色夹趾凉鞋，鞋面有一条宽带，侧面配有金属搭扣。鞋面看起来光滑、哑光；棕褐色鞋床下方是斑驳的棕色软木质感中底和黑色凹凸纹外底。

B004QMSTGA.en: A tan-brown moccasin-style slipper has a suede-like upper, brown laces, and a pale fluffy lining visible around the opening. Its thick brown rubber sole has a low heel and a textured edge.
B004QMSTGA.zh: 这是一只棕褐色莫卡辛风格的拖鞋，鞋面呈麂皮质感，配有棕色鞋带，鞋口露出浅色绒毛内衬。厚实的棕色橡胶鞋底带有低跟和纹理边缘。

B00421BLAG.en: This is a low-cut athletic running shoe with a coral-pink mesh toe and outsole, black and dark gray panels, and white accents. The upper looks like mesh and synthetic material, with black laces through reinforced loops; the thick white sole has deep rounded grooves and coral-pink tread underneath.
B00421BLAG.zh: 这是一款低帮运动跑鞋，珊瑚粉色网布鞋头和外底搭配黑色、深灰色拼片及白色装饰。鞋面看起来由网布和合成材料制成，黑色鞋带穿过加固鞋眼；厚实的白色鞋底带有深圆槽，底面是珊瑚粉色纹路。

B004WJBZ54.en: A white and black cross-training shoe with a smooth, perforated leather-like upper and a large outlined N on the side. It has white laces, a padded black collar, and a thick white sole with black trim and gray tread sections.
B004WJBZ54.zh: 这是一只黑白相间的交叉训练鞋，鞋面看起来光滑，带有透气孔，材质类似皮革，侧面有醒目的描边字母“N”。鞋带为白色，鞋口有黑色衬垫；厚实的白色鞋底带黑色饰边和灰色纹路区域。

B0055X2TEC.en: A black open-toe sport sandal with a molded footbed and a thick, deeply grooved rubber sole. Its upper is made of wide fabric straps that cross the foot and wrap around the ankle, with adjustable hook-and-loop closures and a plastic buckle.
B0055X2TEC.zh: 这是一款黑色露趾运动凉鞋，带有成型鞋床和厚实、纹路较深的橡胶鞋底。鞋面由宽幅织物带组成，交叉覆盖脚背并绕过脚踝，以可调节的粘扣带和塑料扣固定。

B0054P9AM0.en: A black trail-running shoe has a breathable-looking mesh upper with turquoise panels and bright lime-green accents. It fastens with lime-green laces, and has a thick black sole with lime-green tread and turquoise details at the heel.
B0054P9AM0.zh: 这是一只黑色越野跑鞋，鞋面看起来是透气网布，配有蓝绿色面板和鲜亮的黄绿色装饰。鞋带为黄绿色，鞋底厚实、呈黑色，带有黄绿色纹路和蓝绿色后跟细节。

B0055ATVV4.en: A black open-toe sandal has patterned dark fabric straps with small blue and gray details. The straps fasten with hook-and-loop tabs around the forefoot, instep, and ankle, above a thick black sole with a ridged tread.
B0055ATVV4.zh: 这是一只黑色露趾凉鞋，深色织物鞋带上带有蓝色和灰色的小图案。鞋带通过粘扣带固定在前脚掌、脚背和脚踝处，下方是厚实的黑色鞋底，底面带有凹凸纹路。

B005CMIIBY.en: A black slip-on slipper with a rounded toe and a wool-like, textured upper. A wide strap crosses the top and fastens with a hook-and-loop closure; the sole is thick, black, and slightly ridged along the edge.
B005CMIIBY.zh: 这是一只黑色圆头套脚拖鞋，鞋面呈羊毛般的纹理。鞋面有一条宽带横跨其上，并以粘扣带固定；鞋底厚实、为黑色，边缘略带纹路。

B005DJ227C.en: A tall black rain boot with a smooth, matte-looking upper and a textured band around the top. It has no visible fastener, a rounded toe, and a thick black sole with a low block heel.
B005DJ227C.zh: 这是一双黑色高筒雨靴，鞋面光滑、呈哑光质感，靴口有一圈纹理饰边。看不到明显的扣合装置；鞋头圆润，黑色鞋底较厚，带低矮的方跟。

B0055ATVUU.en: A flip-flop with a dark brown footbed and a tan-and-brown woven-looking strap. The strap splits into a Y shape and fastens between the toes; the sole is a thick, flat dark layer with a slightly uneven edge.
B0055ATVUU.zh: 这是一只夹脚拖鞋，深棕色鞋床上配有棕褐色与棕色相间、看起来像编织材质的鞋带。鞋带呈 Y 形，并夹在脚趾之间；鞋底是厚实、平坦的深色鞋底，边缘略显不平整。

B005DVY6B0.en: A black open-toe sandal has wide straps with large silver-tone buckles, and the upper looks smooth and slightly glossy. It has a tan footbed and a thick, woodgrain-patterned platform sole with a raised heel.
B005DVY6B0.zh: 这是一只黑色露趾凉鞋，宽鞋带配有大号银色搭扣，鞋面看起来光滑并带些光泽。鞋垫为棕褐色，厚实的木纹图案坡跟鞋底后跟较高。

B005EP1FCS.en: A dark charcoal hiking shoe with a leather-like upper, mesh panels, and small orange-red accents. It fastens with dark laces through fabric loops and metal eyelets, above a thick black, deeply lugged sole.
B005EP1FCS.zh: 这是一只深炭灰色的徒步鞋，鞋面看起来像皮革，并带有网布区域和橙红色点缀。深色鞋带穿过织物鞋环和金属鞋眼，下面是厚实、带有深沟纹路的黑色鞋底。

B005HMTPBG.en: A black closed-toe sport sandal has a textured synthetic-looking upper, with pink-and-black cord laces threaded through webbing and tightened by a toggle. It has open cutouts at the sides and a thick, dark gray rubber sole with a ridged tread.
B005HMTPBG.zh: 这是一只黑色包头运动凉鞋，鞋面看起来带有纹理，像合成材料制成；粉黑相间的绳状鞋带穿过织带，并用扣钮收紧。鞋身两侧有镂空，配有厚实的深灰色橡胶鞋底和带纹路的底面。

B005UVNE9S.en: A black running shoe with a mesh-and-suede-looking upper, gray accents, and a large outlined N on the side. It has black laces and a thick white and gray sole with sculpted panels and a dark section under the heel.
B005UVNE9S.zh: 这是一只黑色跑鞋，鞋面看起来由网布和麂皮样材质拼成，并带有灰色细节和侧面的醒目镂空风格字母“N”。鞋带为黑色，厚鞋底为白色和灰色，带有立体分层纹路，后跟下方还有一块深色部分。

B00605L38M.en: A low-top sneaker with a dark navy upper that looks like suede, white side stripes, and a small gold logo. It fastens with navy laces, and has a thick white rubber sole with a textured sidewall.
B00605L38M.zh: 这是一双深海军蓝色低帮运动鞋，鞋面看起来像绒面革，侧面有白色条纹和小金色标志。鞋带为海军蓝色，鞋底厚实、呈白色，侧边带有纹理。

B005O65HKI.en: A black slip-on clog-style shoe with a smooth, slightly textured leather-like upper and a raised heel collar. It has no visible laces or fastener, and a thick black sole with molded curved details and tread.
B005O65HKI.zh: 这是一只黑色套脚式便鞋，鞋面光滑，带有轻微纹理，看起来像皮革，后跟鞋口略高。鞋面没有可见的鞋带或扣件，配有厚实的黑色鞋底，带有弧形压模细节和防滑纹路。

B005GI8UZ8.en: A taupe slip-on walking shoe has a textured fabric upper, with a smooth darker toe panel and a raised tongue-like section at the opening. It has no visible laces or other fastener, and a thick off-white sole with deep separated tread blocks and a thin black stripe.
B005GI8UZ8.zh: 这是一只灰褐色的套穿式步行鞋，鞋面为有纹理的织物，鞋头有一块较光滑、颜色较深的拼片，鞋口处还有凸起的舌状部分。看不到鞋带或其他扣合装置；厚实的米白色鞋底带有间隔较深的块状纹路和一道细黑条。

B0067TZ1D4.en: A low-top sneaker with a black canvas-looking upper and a dark polo-player emblem on the side. It fastens with black laces, and has a thick white rubber sole with fine horizontal grooves.
B0067TZ1D4.zh: 这是一双低帮运动鞋，鞋面看起来是黑色帆布，侧面有深色马球骑手标志。鞋带为黑色，鞋底是厚实的白色橡胶，带有细密的横向纹路。

B006H30L3K.en: A black and gray running shoe with red and silver stripes has a mesh upper with smooth overlays. It fastens with black laces and has a thick white sole with gray and black sections.
B006H30L3K.zh: 这是一只黑色和灰色的跑鞋，带有红色和银色条纹；鞋面为网眼材质，并有光滑的覆层。鞋带为黑色，鞋底较厚，以白色为主，带有灰色和黑色部分。

B006MNXS9O.en: A dark charcoal casual sneaker has a layered, leather-like upper with tan contrast stitching and beige laces. It fastens with laces and has a thick, dark, segmented rubber sole with rounded sections.
B006MNXS9O.zh: 这是一款深炭灰色休闲运动鞋，鞋面呈分层拼接的皮革质感，并带有棕褐色对比缝线和米色鞋带。鞋带系合，厚实的深色橡胶鞋底由圆润的分段组成。

B006O5ENC6.en: A brown and charcoal walking shoe with a suede-like upper and dark mesh panels. It has gray-and-black laces and a thick light-gray sole with a black, ridged tread.
B006O5ENC6.zh: 这是一只棕色和炭灰色的步行鞋，鞋面看起来像绒面革，并带有深色网布拼片。鞋带为灰黑色，厚实的浅灰色鞋底配有黑色凹凸纹路。

B0078J8BF2.en: A tall brown winter boot has a dark, textured fabric upper with suede-like panels and a black padded collar. Dark laces run through metal eyelets and hooks, above a thick black rubber lower shell and deeply ridged sole.
B0078J8BF2.zh: 这是一只棕色高筒冬靴，鞋面为深色纹理织物，拼有麂皮质感的面板，鞋口带黑色填充。深色鞋带穿过金属鞋孔和挂钩，下面是厚实的黑色橡胶鞋壳和深纹鞋底。

B007HIPFTO.en: A gray walking shoe with a mix of suede-like panels and mesh, plus light blue accents and a logo. It fastens with blue-gray laces, and has a thick white sole with a pale blue edge.
B007HIPFTO.zh: 这是一只灰色步行鞋，鞋面由绒面质感拼片和网布组成，并带有浅蓝色细节和标志。鞋带为蓝灰色，鞋底厚实、呈白色，边缘带浅蓝色。

B007AAYWZC.en: A low-cut athletic walking shoe with a white mesh upper, gray-and-black patterned laces, and a small toggle fastener. It has a thick white sole with a few dark tread sections visible underneath.
B007AAYWZC.zh: 这是一只低帮运动步行鞋，鞋面为白色网布，配有灰黑相间的图案鞋带和小型束带扣。鞋底厚实、呈白色，底部可见几处深色防滑纹路。

B0072GC6L6.en: A brown low-top sneaker with a suede-like upper, dark gray toe and heel panels, and contrasting light stitching. It fastens with black laces through metal eyelets and has a thick, segmented light gray sole with a dark rubber toe edge.
B0072GC6L6.zh: 这是一款棕色低帮运动鞋，鞋面看起来像绒面革，配有深灰色鞋头和后跟拼片，以及颜色鲜明的浅色缝线。鞋带为黑色，穿过金属鞋眼；厚实的浅灰色鞋底带有分块纹路，鞋头边缘为深色橡胶。

B007IFWHRY.en: A brown leather-look sandal has a wide strap across the toes and an adjustable ankle strap with a metal buckle. Its sole has a mottled brown footbed and a black textured bottom.
B007IFWHRY.zh: 这是一款棕色皮革质感凉鞋，鞋头有宽带，脚踝处有带金属扣的可调节搭带。鞋底上层呈斑驳棕色，底面为黑色并带有纹路。

B00828VKFQ.en: A black slip-on work shoe with a smooth, leather-like upper and a rounded toe. It has no visible laces or buckle, and a thick black sole with a stitched seam around the edge.
B00828VKFQ.zh: 这是一只黑色套穿式工作鞋，鞋面光滑，外观像皮革，鞋头圆润。没有可见的鞋带或搭扣，厚黑色鞋底边缘有一圈缝线。

B007M8575G.en: A low-cut golf shoe in dark gray, with a textured fabric-looking upper, three white side stripes, and a small red logo on the tongue. It fastens with gray laces and has a white midsole above a black-and-white sole with short rubber cleats and red sections underneath.
B007M8575G.zh: 这是一只深灰色低帮高尔夫球鞋，鞋面看起来是有纹理的织物材质，侧面有三道白色条纹，鞋舌上有一个小红色标志。鞋带为灰色；白色中底下方是黑白相间的外底，带有短橡胶鞋钉和红色部分。

B0087XTDFU.en: A brown leather boat shoe with pale contrast stitching and white laces threaded through metal eyelets and side openings. It has a thick, off-white rubber sole with a low profile.
B0087XTDFU.zh: 这是一只棕色皮革船鞋，带有浅色对比缝线；白色鞋带穿过金属鞋眼和鞋侧开孔。鞋底为厚实、低帮的米白色橡胶底。

B0088WEN1O.en: A black and gray trail-running shoe with red accents has a mesh upper reinforced with black overlays and bold white-outlined side stripes. It fastens with red-trimmed laces, and the thick dark gray sole has a sculpted side and red tread underneath.
B0088WEN1O.zh: 这是一只黑色和灰色、带红色点缀的越野跑鞋，网布鞋面覆有黑色加固片，侧面有醒目的白边条纹。鞋带边缘带红色饰边；厚实的深灰色鞋底侧面起伏分明，底部可见红色鞋纹。

B008GRM6UG.en: A dark navy closed-toe sandal has a fabric-looking upper with light contrast stitching and olive-colored lining. It fastens with a wide hook-and-loop strap across the top, and has a thick, dark brown sole with a textured edge.
B008GRM6UG.zh: 这是一只深海军蓝色的包头凉鞋，鞋面看起来像布料，配有浅色对比缝线，内衬呈橄榄色。鞋面上方有一条宽大的粘扣带，鞋底厚实、呈深棕色，边缘带有纹理。

B008JE8WUY.en: A black closed-toe sandal has a dark fabric upper with curved cutout straps and a closed toe bumper. It fastens with a hook-and-loop ankle strap, and has a thick, sculpted gray midsole over a black treaded outsole.
B008JE8WUY.zh: 这是一款黑色包头凉鞋，鞋面看起来是深色织物，带有弧形镂空绑带和包头护片。脚踝处用魔术贴搭扣固定，厚实的灰色中底下方是黑色纹路外底。

B008HDZ4ZS.en: A white, open-toe sandal has a strappy upper with a flower-shaped detail and small gold-tone beads. It fastens with a hook-and-loop ankle strap and has a thick black wedge sole with visible stitching around the edge.
B008HDZ4ZS.zh: 这是一只白色露趾凉鞋，鞋面由带状结构组成，饰有花朵造型和几颗金色小珠。脚踝处的搭带以粘扣固定，厚实的黑色坡跟鞋底边缘可见缝线。

B008M4Z8E4.en: A reddish-brown ballet flat has a rounded toe and a low-cut opening. Its smooth-looking upper has stitched edging and a slightly textured heel section; it has no visible fastening, and a thin dark sole with a small heel.
B008M4Z8E4.zh: 这是一只红棕色芭蕾平底鞋，鞋头圆润，鞋口较低。鞋面看起来较光滑，边缘有缝线，后跟部分略带纹理；看不到明显的闭合装置，鞋底薄而深色，带有小鞋跟。

B008TML4G0.en: A black open-toe sport sandal with a strappy upper that looks like smooth leather. It fastens with broad hook-and-loop straps across the front and over the ankle, and has a thick, black molded sole with a ridged tread.
B008TML4G0.zh: 这是一只黑色露趾运动凉鞋，带有看起来光滑的皮革鞋面和多条带子。前部和脚踝上方用宽幅粘扣带固定，厚实的黑色模压鞋底带有凹凸纹路。

B008KLRTHS.en: This is a flip-flop sandal with a black sole and orange straps patterned with small multicoloured lines. The woven-looking straps cross over the foot and loop between the toes; there is no visible buckle or other fastening.
B008KLRTHS.zh: 这是一只人字拖凉鞋，黑色鞋底配有带细小多色线条图案的橙色鞋带。鞋带看起来像编织织物，在脚背交叉并穿过脚趾间；没有可见的搭扣或其他固定装置。

B00913JPPI.en: A black low-cut athletic sneaker with a smooth, fabric-like upper and a mesh-textured tongue and collar. It has elastic crisscross straps over the instep instead of visible laces, and a thick black sole with deep segmented grooves.
B00913JPPI.zh: 这是一只黑色低帮运动鞋，鞋面光滑，质感像织物，鞋舌和鞋口带有网状纹理。鞋背上有交叉弹力带，没有明显的鞋带；厚实的黑色鞋底带有深刻的分段纹路。

B00B1I5V4U.en: A black slip-on loafer with a glossy leather-like upper, stitched apron, and two tassels across the vamp. It has a low black sole with a small heel.
B00B1I5V4U.zh: 这是一双黑色套穿式便鞋，鞋面看起来有光泽，类似皮革，带有缝线围边和鞋面流苏。鞋底为黑色低跟款式。

B00ASJ8OPG.en: A black low-cut walking shoe with a smooth, suede-like upper, stitched overlays, and a small logo on the side. It has no visible laces; a broad tongue sits over the opening, and the thick gray sole has a rugged black tread.
B00ASJ8OPG.zh: 这是一只黑色低帮步行鞋，鞋面看起来像绒面革，带有缝线拼接和侧面小标志。没有可见鞋带；宽舌片覆在鞋口上，厚实的灰色鞋底带有粗纹黑色外底。

B009VZLAPY.en: A black low-top athletic sneaker has a textile-looking upper with stitched panels and a large silver S on the side. It fastens with black laces threaded through gray fabric loops, above a thick black sole with deep grooves and segmented blocks.
B009VZLAPY.zh: 这是一只黑色低帮运动鞋，鞋面看起来像织物材质，并有拼接缝线和侧面的银色大写 S 标志。黑色鞋带穿过灰色织带环来系紧，下面是厚实的黑色鞋底，带有深槽和分块纹路。

B00BMM04K6.en: A blue and bright yellow running shoe with a mesh upper, layered synthetic-looking overlays, and blue laces. Its thick blue-and-white sole has yellow sections and segmented translucent-looking cushioning visible along the sides.
B00BMM04K6.zh: 这是一只蓝色和亮黄色的跑鞋，鞋面为网布，并有层叠的合成材质外覆片和蓝色鞋带。厚实的蓝白色鞋底带有黄色部分，侧面可见分段的半透明外观缓震结构。

B00B8PPS6M.en: A teal and white patterned sport sandal with an open toe and woven-looking fabric straps. The straps fasten with adjustable hook-and-loop tabs around the toes and ankle, and the sandal has a thick black sole with a textured footbed.
B00B8PPS6M.zh: 这是一只绿松石色与白色图案相间的露趾运动凉鞋，鞋带看起来像织物。鞋带通过脚趾处和脚踝处可调节的粘扣带固定，配有厚实的黑色鞋底和带纹理的鞋床。

B00D7CHAEW.en: A brown and gray low-cut hiking shoe with a suede-like upper, mesh panels, and a black rubber toe cap. It fastens with black-and-tan laces, and has a thick, dark lugged sole.
B00D7CHAEW.zh: 这是一只棕灰色低帮徒步鞋，鞋面看起来像绒面革，并带有网布拼片和黑色橡胶鞋头。鞋带为黑色和棕褐色，鞋底厚实、颜色较深，带有凸起的防滑纹路。

B00D0UKPF2.en: A dark brown slip-on loafer with a smooth, shiny-looking upper, a raised front seam, and a broad vamp panel. It has no visible fastener, and a black, ridged sole with a low heel.
B00D0UKPF2.zh: 这是一只深棕色套穿乐福鞋，鞋面看起来光滑有光泽，鞋头有凸起的缝线，鞋面前部有一块宽面板。没有可见的扣件，黑色鞋底带有沟纹，并配有低鞋跟。

B00BRCBBYY.en: A tan moccasin-style flat has a rounded toe and a low, enclosed heel. Its upper looks like soft leather, with visible stitching and a raised leather lace decoration; it slips on without a visible fastener. The thin sole is tan and has a lightly textured surface.
B00BRCBBYY.zh: 这是一只棕褐色莫卡辛风格平底鞋，鞋头圆润，后跟低而包覆。鞋面看起来像柔软的皮革，有明显的缝线和凸起的皮绳装饰；没有可见的扣合件，直接套穿。薄鞋底呈棕褐色，表面带有轻微纹理。

B00BP69SNI.en: A low-cut slip-on sneaker in mottled taupe and gray, with a suede-like upper, stitched panels, and a dark padded collar. It has a small stretch-gore panel across the instep and a thick, rugged black rubber sole with deep grooves.
B00BP69SNI.zh: 这是一款低帮套穿运动鞋，鞋面呈斑驳的灰褐色，质感像麂皮，并带有拼接缝线和深色软垫鞋口。鞋背有一小块弹性布料，搭配厚实、带深槽纹的黑色橡胶大底。

B00D8FMON0.en: A navy blue slip-on moccasin has a fabric-looking upper with a raised band across the front and three small white stitched accents at the sides. It has no visible laces or buckle, and a thick white rubber sole with deep wavy grooves.
B00D8FMON0.zh: 这是一双藏蓝色套穿式莫卡辛鞋，鞋面看起来像织物，前部有一条凸起的饰带，两侧带有三道白色小缝线装饰。没有可见的鞋带或搭扣，白色厚橡胶鞋底带有深深的波浪形凹槽。

B00D7IDIP6.en: A black slip-on shoe with a soft, suede-like upper and a rounded toe. It has no laces or buckle, and a thick black rubber sole with a textured tread and a gray inset along the side.
B00D7IDIP6.zh: 这是一只黑色套穿鞋，鞋面看起来是柔软的麂皮状材质，鞋头圆润。鞋上没有鞋带或搭扣，配有厚实的黑色橡胶鞋底，底纹凸起，侧面嵌有一条灰色饰片。

B00DZL23D8.en: A dark brown, closed-toe clog with a smooth, shiny leather-looking upper and a raised heel. It has no visible fastener, and the thick dark sole has a low heel and stitched-looking detailing around the edge.
B00DZL23D8.zh: 这是一款深棕色包头木屐鞋，鞋面光滑有光泽，看起来像皮革，后跟略高。鞋面没有可见的扣合装置；深色厚鞋底带低跟，边缘有类似缝线的细节。

B00DJSRER2.en: A black and charcoal-gray athletic sneaker with a mesh-and-synthetic-looking upper, stitched overlays, and a padded collar. It fastens with black laces, and has a thick, rugged gray-and-black sole with deep tread.
B00DJSRER2.zh: 这是一只黑色与炭灰色的运动鞋，鞋面看起来由网布和合成材料拼接而成，并带有缝线装饰和加厚鞋口。鞋带为黑色；厚实的灰黑色鞋底带有深纹路。

B00GRSZCIO.en: A white low-top sneaker with a pale gray-white upper that appears to combine smooth and mesh-like panels. It has elastic lace-style bands across the top, with no visible eyelets, and a thick white sole with a sculpted, textured heel.
B00GRSZCIO.zh: 这是一只白色低帮运动鞋，鞋面呈浅灰白色，似乎由光滑面料和网眼状拼片组成。鞋面上有弹性鞋带状带子，没有明显的鞋带孔；白色厚鞋底带有立体纹路，后跟处纹理较深。

B00E8FRE2K.en: A dark gray slip-on shoe with a breathable-looking mesh upper and a smooth, raised collar. It has no visible fastener, and the thick gray sole has deep grooves and molded ridges along the sides.
B00E8FRE2K.zh: 这是一只深灰色套穿鞋，鞋面是看起来透气的网布，鞋口边缘平滑且略高。看不到任何扣合件；厚实的灰色鞋底带有较深的凹槽，侧面有模压纹路。

B00E7TQG62.en: A pale yellow slip-on sandal has a smooth, molded upper with broad cutout straps crossing over the foot. It has no visible buckle or fastener, and a thick, pale yellow sole with a raised heel and a textured footbed.
B00E7TQG62.zh: 这是一只淡黄色的一脚蹬凉鞋，鞋面为光滑的模压材质，宽带交叠并留有镂空。看不到扣子或其他固定装置；鞋底厚实、同为淡黄色，后跟略高，鞋床带有纹理。

B00H4YC0GC.en: A brown mid-height hiking boot with suede-like panels and black mesh across the tongue and sides. It fastens with black laces through fabric loops and metal hooks, and has a thick, rugged black rubber sole with a raised toe bumper.
B00H4YC0GC.zh: 这是一只棕色中帮登山靴，鞋面有绒面质感的拼片，鞋舌和侧面带黑色网布。鞋带穿过布质环和金属挂钩系紧，底部是厚实、带凸纹的黑色橡胶大底，鞋头有加高包边。

B00I5IGWQ0.en: A dark gray slip-on walking shoe has a knitted-looking fabric upper and a low, rounded toe. It has no visible laces or straps, and a thick white sole with a narrow dark stripe along the side.
B00I5IGWQ0.zh: 这是一只深灰色的套穿式步行鞋，鞋面看起来像针织面料，鞋头较低且圆润。鞋面没有可见的鞋带或搭扣，厚白色鞋底侧面有一道细窄的深色条纹。

B00HDK1POK.en: A brown flip-flop has a textured fabric toe-post strap with a small logo. Its tan footbed has raised circular patterns, and the thick brown sole has a gently raised heel.
B00HDK1POK.zh: 这是一只棕色人字拖，织物带有纹理，带有一处夹趾结构和小标志。棕褐色鞋床上有凸起的圆形纹路，厚棕色鞋底的后跟略微抬高。

B00I8T22FG.en: A tan slide sandal has two wide, textured cork-like straps with small shiny gold-toned flecks. It slips on with no visible fastening, and has a tan footbed above a dark brown, slightly raised sole.
B00I8T22FG.zh: 这是一款棕褐色一字拖凉鞋，鞋面有两条宽宽的纹理带，外观看起来像软木，并点缀着细小的金色亮片。鞋子没有可见的扣合装置，直接套穿；棕褐色鞋床下方是深棕色、略微加厚的鞋底。

B00IY8MNSW.en: A low-cut athletic training shoe has a brown camouflage-patterned upper with suede-like overlays and a bright pink-outlined side logo. Brown laces fasten it, and its thick, sculpted light-gray sole has black sections underneath.
B00IY8MNSW.zh: 这是一款低帮运动训练鞋，棕色迷彩图案鞋面搭配类似麂皮的拼接部分，侧面有粉色描边标志。鞋带为棕色，厚实的浅灰色鞋底线条起伏，底部可见黑色部分。

B00IKD8YE8.en: A black open-toe slide slipper with a wide upper made of soft-looking textured fabric and a narrow shiny trim along its edge. It has no fastening, and the dark sole is flat with a slightly raised rim.
B00IKD8YE8.zh: 这是一只黑色露趾拖鞋，宽鞋面看起来由柔软的纹理织物制成，边缘有一圈窄窄的亮面饰边。鞋子没有扣合设计，深色鞋底较平，边缘略微凸起。

B00JA7TRXK.en: A black slip-on loafer with a textured, leather-like upper, stitched panels, and a small elastic gore on the side. It has a thick black rubber sole with a ridged tread.
B00JA7TRXK.zh: 这是一款黑色套脚便鞋，鞋面有纹理，外观似皮革，并带有拼接缝线和侧边小块松紧布。鞋底较厚，为黑色橡胶材质，底面带有凹凸纹路。

B00J0RX7TU.en: A gray closed-toe slipper has a fuzzy, cable-knit-looking upper and a plush lining folded around the opening. It has no visible fastening and a thick gray sole with small ridges underneath.
B00J0RX7TU.zh: 这是一只灰色包头拖鞋，鞋面呈绒毛质感和麻花针织纹理，鞋口围着一圈蓬松的绒毛内衬。鞋上看不到扣合装置，鞋底厚实、呈灰色，底面带有小凹凸纹路。

B00L4TP3NK.en: A gray slip-on walking shoe has a dark gray-and-black patterned knit upper, with a smooth gray panel across the toe. It has no laces or visible fastener, and a thick white sole with rounded segmented sections and a thin dark stripe.
B00L4TP3NK.zh: 这是一只灰色一脚蹬步行鞋，鞋面为深灰与黑色交织的针织图案，鞋头有一块光滑的灰色拼片。鞋上没有鞋带或可见的扣合件，厚白色鞋底带有圆弧分段和一道细深色条纹。

B00KBOJ4DE.en: This is a closed-toe clog slipper with a burgundy suede-like upper and a brown-and-cream knitted collar. The collar has a dark button at the side, and the shoe has a thick, dark gray, flat sole.
B00KBOJ4DE.zh: 这是一款包头木屐式拖鞋，酒红色鞋面呈麂皮质感，鞋口有棕色和奶油色编织翻边。鞋口侧面有一颗深色纽扣，底部是厚实的深灰色平底鞋底。

B00KYPPIG2.en: A white, low-cut ballerina slipper has a soft-looking terry cloth upper with small pink, blue, and purple embroidered flowers, and a small bow at the toe. It has no visible fastening, and a thin, pale sole follows the shape of the shoe.
B00KYPPIG2.zh: 这是一只白色低口芭蕾舞鞋式拖鞋，鞋面看起来是毛圈布，点缀着粉色、蓝色和紫色的小花刺绣，鞋头有一个小蝴蝶结。没有可见的系扣或搭扣，薄薄的浅色鞋底沿着鞋身轮廓延伸。

B00JA7TS34.en: A brown ankle-high slip-on boot with a smooth, suede-like upper, stitched panels, and elastic side gussets. It has a thick black rubber sole with deep tread and a thin brown stripe.
B00JA7TS34.zh: 这是一只棕色的中筒套穿靴，鞋面看起来光滑且带绒面质感，拼接处有缝线，两侧有松紧布。鞋底厚实，为黑色橡胶材质，带有较深的纹路和一道细棕色条纹。

B00L522Z0U.en: A black slip-on walking shoe has a textured, mesh-like fabric upper and no visible laces or buckle. Its thick black sole has deep, rounded tread sections, and the heel has a small pull loop.
B00L522Z0U.zh: 这是一只黑色套穿式步行鞋，鞋面呈网布般的纹理，没有可见的鞋带或搭扣。黑色厚鞋底带有深而圆润的凸起纹路，后跟有一个小拉环。

B00LFAXBVO.en: A black slip-on sneaker with a textured knit-looking upper and smooth black overlays around the toe and sides. It has no visible laces, and the thick black sole has a ridged, segmented look.
B00LFAXBVO.zh: 这是一款黑色套穿式运动鞋，鞋面呈纹理针织状，鞋头和侧面有光滑的黑色拼接层。鞋面没有可见鞋带，厚实的黑色鞋底带有沟纹和分段式外观。

B00M0FBFNO.en: A gray flip-flop sandal has a textured fabric upper with a V-shaped thong strap and a bright pink panel beneath it. It has no buckle or closure, and a thick white sole with deep, rounded tread grooves.
B00M0FBFNO.zh: 这是一只灰色人字拖凉鞋，织物鞋面带有纹理，V形夹趾带下方露出一块亮粉色拼片。它没有搭扣或其他闭合装置，厚白色鞋底带有深而圆润的凹槽纹路。

B00L5FY6HC.en: This is a toe-post sandal with slim, shiny silver straps and a small bow-like detail near the front. It slips on, and has a pale beige footbed with a dark, gently curved outsole.
B00L5FY6HC.zh: 这是一款人字拖凉鞋，带有纤细亮银色鞋带，前部有一个小蝴蝶结样装饰。鞋子直接穿脱，浅米色鞋垫下方是深色、略微弯曲的鞋底。

B00NC2M8MQ.en: A black open-toe sandal with a molded-looking upper and several broad straps. The straps fasten with adjustable hook-and-loop tabs, and the thick black sole has a rugged, deeply treaded bottom.
B00NC2M8MQ.zh: 这是一款黑色露趾凉鞋，鞋面看起来像模压材质，由几条宽鞋带组成。鞋带通过可调节的钩环搭扣固定，厚实的黑色鞋底底面有明显的深纹路。

B00MDKWT1I.en: A tall white snow boot has a quilted-looking synthetic upper, a fluffy white collar, and white laces threaded through side loops and straps with snap buttons. Its thick white rubber sole has a thin black stripe and a ridged tread.
B00MDKWT1I.zh: 这是一只白色高筒雪地靴，鞋面看起来带有绗缝纹理，配有白色绒毛靴口；白色鞋带穿过侧面的鞋环和带按扣的搭带。厚白色橡胶鞋底带有一道细黑线，底部有凸纹。

B00MIFVYSC.en: A gray slip-on flat has a rounded toe and a wide fabric band crossing the upper, which appears to be textured knit. It has no visible fastener, and a thin, smooth gray sole.
B00MIFVYSC.zh: 这是一只灰色圆头套穿平底鞋，鞋面有一条宽织物带横跨其上，材质看起来是带纹理的针织面料。鞋上没有可见的扣合装置，配有薄而平滑的灰色鞋底。

B00M0IZH4O.en: A taupe-grey strappy sandal with a pale beige footbed and turquoise stitching on some of the straps. The upper looks like stitched synthetic material, with overlapping straps and a hook-and-loop fastening; the thick taupe sole has curved grooves and small turquoise accents.
B00M0IZH4O.zh: 这是一只灰褐色的多带凉鞋，配浅米色鞋床，部分鞋带上有蓝绿色缝线。鞋面看起来是带缝线的合成材料，由交叠的鞋带组成，并以粘扣带固定；厚实的灰褐色鞋底有弧形凹槽和小块蓝绿色装饰。

B00NR41ASW.en: A white and light-gray athletic sneaker with a perforated synthetic-looking upper and dark mesh panels. It has white laces through fabric loops and eyelets, plus a thick sculpted white sole with black tread and dark cutout accents.
B00NR41ASW.zh: 这是一只白色和浅灰色的运动鞋，鞋面看起来是带透气孔的合成材料，并配有深色网布拼片。鞋带为白色，穿过织物鞋袢和鞋孔；厚实的白色鞋底造型起伏，带有黑色鞋底纹路和深色镂空装饰。

B00Q0CCM30.en: A gray thong sandal has a textured fabric upper with a toe post and two straps meeting between the toes. It has a dark charcoal footbed and a thin black sole with a narrow light-colored edge.
B00Q0CCM30.zh: 这是一只灰色人字拖凉鞋，织物鞋面带有纹理，鞋带在脚趾间汇合。鞋床为深炭灰色，鞋底较薄、呈黑色，边缘有一条窄窄的浅色线。

B00Q2JC290.en: A gray and black trail-running shoe has a mesh upper with blue accents and gray overlays, and it fastens with dark laces. Its thick gray sole has sculpted grooves and blue tread underneath.
B00Q2JC290.zh: 这是一只灰黑色越野跑鞋，网布鞋面带有蓝色点缀和灰色覆层，以深色鞋带系紧。厚实的灰色鞋底带有凹槽，底部可见蓝色纹路。

B00PY31GSI.en: A black running shoe with white crossing side stripes and turquoise and purple accents. The upper looks like mesh with synthetic overlays, and it fastens with purple laces. Its thick, layered sole is turquoise, white, purple, and black.
B00PY31GSI.zh: 这是一只黑色跑鞋，侧面有交叉的白色条纹，并带有青绿色和紫色点缀。鞋面看起来是网布配合合成材料饰片，系紫色鞋带。厚实的分层鞋底由青绿色、白色、紫色和黑色组成。

B00QILNEVC.en: A black flip-flop sandal with a textured footbed and black fabric straps, including a toe post. The straps hold the foot without a buckle, and the thick black sole has a visible clear window near the heel.
B00QILNEVC.zh: 这是一只黑色人字拖凉鞋，鞋床带有纹理，黑色织物鞋带中有一条夹趾带。鞋带无需搭扣即可固定脚部，厚实的黑色鞋底在后跟附近有一个透明窗口。

B00R88X1IA.en: A dark gray and black athletic sneaker has a textured mesh upper with gray overlay panels and a padded collar. It fastens with gray laces, and has a thick, sculpted gray midsole above a rugged black treaded outsole.
B00R88X1IA.zh: 这是一只深灰色和黑色的运动鞋，鞋面为纹理网布，并带有灰色拼接覆盖层和加厚鞋口。鞋带为灰色；厚实的灰色中底下方是纹路粗犷的黑色外底。

B00Q4V24RQ.en: A black and charcoal running shoe with bright coral-red lining and accents, plus silver and pale blue overlays. The upper looks like mesh with synthetic overlays and red-trimmed stitching; it fastens with red laces. The thick dark gray sole has sculpted grooves and coral-red sections along the bottom and sides.
B00Q4V24RQ.zh: 这是一只黑色和炭灰色的跑鞋，配有亮珊瑚红色的内衬和点缀，以及银色和浅蓝色的覆片。鞋面看起来是网布搭配合成材质覆片，并带有红色滚边的缝线；鞋带为红色。厚实的深灰色鞋底带有雕塑感凹槽，底部和侧面可见珊瑚红色部分。

B00RHNHVBE.en: A light gray, low-cut slip-on walking shoe with a fine knit-looking upper and a stretchy opening, without laces or other visible fasteners. It has a rounded tan toe and a thick sole with a brown band above chunky white and gray tread blocks.
B00RHNHVBE.zh: 这是一只浅灰色低帮套穿式步行鞋，鞋面看起来像细密针织面料，开口有弹性，没有鞋带或其他可见的扣合装置。鞋头圆润、呈棕褐色；厚鞋底上方有一圈棕色部分，下方是块状的白色和灰色鞋纹。

B00TFG2SVO.en: A navy blue two-eye boat shoe has a fabric-looking upper patterned with small colorful flag shapes and white laces threaded through metal eyelets. It has a low, off-white rubber sole with a slightly ridged edge.
B00TFG2SVO.zh: 这是一只海军蓝色的双眼帆船鞋，鞋面看起来像布料，上面印有小巧的彩色旗帜图案，白色鞋带穿过金属鞋眼。鞋底较低，呈米白色橡胶质感，边缘略带纹路。

B00RE2VZHO.en: A clog-style shoe has a black, perforated upper with bright yellow-green accents at the toe, sole, and heel strap. The strap pivots around the heel and has a small side button; the thick sole is black at the heel with a wavy yellow-green edge and tread underneath.
B00RE2VZHO.zh: 这是一款木屐式鞋，黑色鞋面布满透气孔，鞋头、鞋底和后跟带饰有亮黄绿色部分。后跟带可转动，侧面有一枚小圆扣；厚鞋底后跟为黑色，边缘呈波浪状黄绿色，底面带有纹路。

B00TPW7W1E.en: This is a black slip-on water shoe with red trim and a red heel collar. The upper looks like mesh with smooth fabric panels, and it fastens with a cord and toggle at the back. It has a thick black rubber-looking sole with a textured edge.
B00TPW7W1E.zh: 这是一只黑色套穿式涉水鞋，带有红色饰边和红色后跟鞋口。鞋面看起来是网布搭配光滑的织物拼片，后部用抽绳和扣件收紧。鞋底较厚，呈黑色，边缘带有纹理。

B00UAIKMCI.en: A pink slide sandal has a wide, woven-looking pink-and-dark patterned upper with a pale blue strip across it. It has no visible fastening, and the thick pink sole has a gently wavy side profile.
B00UAIKMCI.zh: 这是一只粉色套穿凉鞋，宽鞋面呈粉色与深色相间的编织状纹理，上面横搭着一条浅蓝色带子。看不到明显的扣合装置；厚实的粉色鞋底侧面略呈波浪形。

B00UJU33KK.en: A closed-toe clog with a glossy, dark reddish-brown leather-looking upper and a black interior. It has no visible fastening, and the thick black sole has a low heel and a ridged edge.
B00UJU33KK.zh: 这是一款包头木屐鞋，鞋面看起来是有光泽的深红棕色皮革，内里为黑色。鞋面没有可见的扣合装置；厚实的黑色鞋底带有低跟和纹路边缘。

B00UOWREB2.en: A white and light-gray athletic sneaker with a synthetic-looking upper, dark accents, and a side logo. It has laces through fabric loops and a thick, rugged black rubber sole with deep tread.
B00UOWREB2.zh: 这是一只白色和浅灰色的运动鞋，鞋面看起来像合成材料，带有深色点缀和侧面标志。鞋带穿过织物鞋环，搭配厚实、带深纹路的黑色橡胶鞋底。

B00UKCY3MY.en: A black low-cut athletic-style shoe with a mesh-and-synthetic-looking upper and black lace-up fastening. It has a thick, rugged black sole with deep tread and raised sections around the heel and sides.
B00UKCY3MY.zh: 这是一款黑色低帮运动风鞋，鞋面看起来由网布和合成材料制成，采用黑色鞋带系紧。鞋底厚实、粗犷，带有深纹路，鞋跟和两侧还有凸起的部分。

B00UCVPOQC.en: A dark charcoal-gray flat slip-on with a rounded toe and a finely perforated upper. It has no visible fastening, and a thick, dark sole that curves slightly upward at the heel.
B00UCVPOQC.zh: 这是一只深炭灰色的平底套脚鞋，鞋头圆润，鞋面布满细小孔洞。鞋面没有可见的扣合装置，深色鞋底较厚，后跟处略微抬高。

B00UZ2Y92I.en: A black slip-on loafer with a pebbled-looking upper and stitched apron-style toe. It has no visible laces or buckle, and a thick black sole with a ridged tread.
B00UZ2Y92I.zh: 这是一只黑色套穿式乐福鞋，鞋面呈颗粒纹理，鞋头周围有缝线装饰。没有可见的鞋带或搭扣，配有厚实的黑色鞋底和带棱纹的鞋纹。

B00V3N6QYM.en: A black walking shoe with a smooth, leather-like upper, perforated panels, and a dark gray side logo. It fastens with black laces and has a thick black sole with molded grooves and tread.
B00V3N6QYM.zh: 一只黑色步行鞋，鞋面看起来像光滑皮革，带有透气小孔拼片和深灰色侧面标志。鞋带为黑色，鞋底厚实、呈黑色，带有模压纹路和防滑纹。

B00V3ML4MW.en: A white walking shoe with a mesh-textured upper, smooth overlays, and dark navy accents around the collar and logo. White laces fasten it, and the thick white sole has dark tread along the bottom and a gray panel at the heel.
B00V3ML4MW.zh: 这是一只白色步行鞋，鞋面带网眼纹理和光滑拼接层，鞋口与标志处有深海军蓝装饰。白色鞋带系紧鞋面；厚白色鞋底底部带深色纹路，后跟处有灰色拼片。

B00VNKAA9W.en: A black low-top sneaker with white and gray panels and small teal and pink accents. The upper appears to be a mix of smooth and mesh-like materials, with white laces through fabric loops. It has a thick, sculpted white sole with gray details and black-and-pink sections along the bottom.
B00VNKAA9W.zh: 这是一只黑色低帮运动鞋，带有白色和灰色拼片，以及少量青绿色和粉色点缀。鞋面看起来由光滑材质和网眼状材质拼成，白色鞋带穿过织物鞋环。鞋底厚实有雕塑感，以白色为主，带灰色细节，底部还有黑色和粉色部分。

B00WR255YK.en: A dark navy slip-on loafer has a textured knit-looking upper and a wide elastic panel across the instep, with no laces. It has a thick light gray sole with shallow grooves and a dark trim along the edge.
B00WR255YK.zh: 这是一只深海军蓝色的套穿式便鞋，鞋面呈纹理针织状，鞋背有宽幅弹性拼片，没有鞋带。鞋底厚实，呈浅灰色，带有浅槽，边缘有一圈深色饰边。

B00W7WYT4W.en: A black open-toe wedge sandal has wide crossing straps over the forefoot and a wraparound ankle strap decorated with rows of colorful beads and pearls. It fastens around the ankle; the thick platform wedge has a multicolored woven-looking surface and a thin brown outsole.
B00W7WYT4W.zh: 这是一只黑色露趾坡跟凉鞋，前掌有宽交叉鞋带，绕踝鞋带上饰有多排彩色珠子和珍珠。鞋带绕踝固定；厚底坡跟表面呈多色编织状，底部有一层薄薄的棕色外底。

B013J9XJ38.en: A low-top sneaker has a blue, finely textured fabric upper with black laces and trim. It fastens with laces, and its thick black rubber sole has deep, rounded tread blocks.
B013J9XJ38.zh: 这是一只低帮运动鞋，蓝色鞋面呈细密织物纹理，配有黑色鞋带和饰边。鞋带系合，厚实的黑色橡胶鞋底带有深而圆润的块状纹路。

B014K5ZLOA.en: A sport sandal with a dark gray footbed and thick gray sole edged in white. Its upper is made of turquoise woven straps with orange and dark accents, and it fastens with adjustable straps and a plastic buckle.
B014K5ZLOA.zh: 这是一款运动凉鞋，配有深灰色鞋床和厚实的灰色鞋底，边缘为白色。鞋面由绿松石色编织带构成，带有橙色和深色点缀，并通过可调节绑带和塑料扣固定。

B0128H3RIO.en: A bright pink closed-toe pump has a soft, suede-like upper and a rounded toe. It has no visible fastening, with a thin brown outsole, a slight platform, and a narrow mid-height heel.
B0128H3RIO.zh: 这是一只亮粉色的包头浅口鞋，鞋面看起来像柔软的绒面材质，鞋头圆润。没有可见的扣带或其他系扣，棕色薄外底配有轻微的前掌厚底和细窄的中高跟。

B00XA01UQK.en: A black lace-up sneaker with a mesh upper and smooth black overlays, including a raised logo on the side. Its thick black sole has deep, widely spaced grooves and a slightly raised heel.
B00XA01UQK.zh: 这是一只黑色系带运动鞋，鞋面为网布，并有光滑的黑色覆层，侧面带凸起的标志。厚实的黑色鞋底有深而宽的沟槽，后跟略微加高。

B015SSPRAQ.en: A black open-toe wedge sandal has a wide front strap and a heel strap, with several narrow black-and-silver striped bands across the instep. The straps look like fabric, and the sandal fastens with a back strap; its black sole rises into a solid wedge heel.
B015SSPRAQ.zh: 这是一款黑色露趾坡跟凉鞋，前部有宽鞋带，脚背上方有几条黑银相间的窄条纹带，后跟有一条鞋带。鞋带看起来像织物，凉鞋通过后跟带固定；黑色鞋底后部形成实心坡跟。

B015IIHVIC.en: This is a dark gray sport sandal with burgundy woven straps crossing over the foot and a strap loop around the toe. The straps fasten with a black buckle near the ankle, and the sandal has a thick black sole with a textured footbed and a ridged outsole.
B015IIHVIC.zh: 这是一款深灰色运动凉鞋，酒红色编织带交叉覆盖脚面，并有一条环绕脚趾的带子。鞋带在脚踝附近用黑色扣具固定；鞋底较厚、呈黑色，鞋床有纹理，外底带有凹凸纹路。

B014UVX31C.en: A dark brown flat sandal has a toe post and curved, interwoven-looking straps across the top, with a buckle at the ankle. The upper looks like textured leather, and the sole has a brown sidewall above a thick, dark rubber-looking bottom.
B014UVX31C.zh: 这是一双深棕色平底凉鞋，带有夹趾带和弯曲交织感的鞋面带，脚踝处有搭扣。鞋面看起来像有纹理的皮革，鞋底侧边为棕色，下方是厚实的深色橡胶感鞋底。

B0163IMBZ4.en: A navy-blue thong sandal has a broad molded strap with a toe post, made of smooth, matte-looking material. It has no buckles or other fastener, and a thick, slightly raised sole with a textured footbed and grooved tread underneath.
B0163IMBZ4.zh: 这是一只海军蓝色的人字拖凉鞋，带有宽大的模制鞋带和夹趾柱，材质看起来光滑、哑光。它没有搭扣或其他固定装置，厚鞋底略微凸起，鞋床有纹理，底面带有沟槽。

B015XJSXEC.en: A dark navy trail-running shoe with a mesh-and-synthetic-looking upper, gray overlays, and bright lime accents. It fastens with black laces, and has a thick, sculpted gray sole with lime tread visible underneath.
B015XJSXEC.zh: 这是一只深海军蓝色越野跑鞋，鞋面看起来由网布和合成材料拼成，带有灰色饰片和亮黄绿色点缀。鞋带为黑色，鞋底厚实且有立体纹路，灰色鞋底下方可见黄绿色外底。

B016N3E84G.en: A black slip-on dress shoe with a smooth, shiny leather-like upper and a short stitched panel on the vamp. It has a low black rubber sole with a small raised heel and textured sides.
B016N3E84G.zh: 这是一双黑色套脚正装鞋，鞋面看起来光滑亮面，类似皮革，鞋背有一小块缝线饰片。黑色橡胶鞋底较低，带有小块凸起的鞋跟和纹理侧边。

B0169V0FVC.en: This is a black slip-on flat with a rounded toe and a floral lace-like fabric upper, edged with smooth black trim. It has no visible fastener, and a thick black rubber sole with deep grooves and segmented tread.
B0169V0FVC.zh: 这是一款黑色套穿式平底鞋，圆头，鞋面呈花朵蕾丝般的织物质感，边缘饰有光滑的黑色包边。看不到明显的扣合装置，黑色橡胶鞋底较厚，带有深槽和分段式纹路。

B016P7VOYW.en: A black slip-on mule has a closed toe, open heel, and a fabric-looking upper with layered stitched bands across the top. It has no visible fastening, and a thick dark-gray sole with deep segmented grooves and a slightly raised heel.
B016P7VOYW.zh: 这是一款黑色套穿式穆勒鞋，鞋头包覆、后跟敞开，鞋面看起来是织物材质，顶部有层叠的缝线带。没有可见的扣合装置，厚实的深灰色鞋底带有明显的分段凹槽，后跟略微加高。

B019XHBF18.en: A navy blue pump has a rounded toe, a closed back, and a tall narrow heel. Its upper appears to be smooth, slightly textured material, with no visible fastener; the dark sole has a raised platform at the front and a thin contrasting edge.
B019XHBF18.zh: 这是一只海军蓝色高跟鞋，圆头、封闭式后跟，配有细长高跟。鞋面看起来是光滑且略带纹理的材质，没有可见的扣合装置；深色鞋底前部略厚，边缘有一条细细的对比色线条。

B016UP2TY8.en: A brown leather hiking boot has a padded ankle collar, colorful striped fabric accents, and bright patterned laces threaded through metal eyelets. It fastens with laces and has a thick, rugged dark gray sole with a black toe bumper.
B016UP2TY8.zh: 这是一只棕色皮革徒步靴，配有加厚鞋口、彩色条纹布饰和穿过金属鞋眼的鲜艳图案鞋带。鞋带用于系紧，鞋底厚实耐磨，呈深灰色，并带有黑色鞋头护边。

B016P9A6GM.en: A light gray and white slip-on sneaker has a rounded toe, with a pale gray textile-and-synthetic-looking upper and darker mesh panels. The top is held by broad elastic bands, and the thick white sole has deep molded grooves and oval cutouts at the heel.
B016P9A6GM.zh: 这是一只浅灰白色的套穿式运动鞋，鞋头圆润，鞋面看起来由浅灰色织物和合成材料拼接而成，并带有深色网布区域。鞋面以宽幅松紧带固定，厚白色鞋底有深刻的凹槽，后跟处带椭圆形镂空。

B0171INEBA.en: A brown moccasin-style slipper with a suede-like upper, visible stitching around the toe, and a cream-colored fuzzy lining. It has a brown bow tie and a low, ribbed tan rubber-looking sole.
B0171INEBA.zh: 这是一只棕色莫卡辛式拖鞋，鞋面看起来像麂皮，鞋头周围有明显的缝线，内里是奶油色绒毛。鞋面系着棕色蝴蝶结，底部是低矮、带棱纹的浅棕色橡胶状鞋底。

B01ACF08HW.en: A low-top athletic sneaker has a densely striped knit upper in black, gray, white, and pink, with black laces and a black padded collar. A thick white sole has deep segmented grooves and a dark trim along the heel.
B01ACF08HW.zh: 这是一只低帮运动鞋，针织鞋面带有密集的黑、灰、白和粉色条纹，配黑色鞋带和黑色衬垫鞋口。厚实的白色鞋底有明显的分段凹槽，后跟处带有深色边缘。

B017CUBWJS.en: A red moccasin-style slipper has a soft-looking suede-like upper, with cream stitching around the toe and a brown tie across the top. It has an open back, a cream fleece-like lining, and a thin, flat beige sole.
B017CUBWJS.zh: 这是一只红色莫卡辛风格的拖鞋，鞋面看起来像柔软的绒面材质，鞋头缝有奶油色缝线，鞋面上系着棕色鞋带。它是露跟款，内里呈奶油色绒毛状，配有薄而平的米 beige 色鞋底。

B01AH00BOW.en: A black slip-on walking shoe with a stretchy-looking knit upper and a small heel pull loop. It has no laces, and the thick black sole has textured sections along the sides.
B01AH00BOW.zh: 这是一只黑色套穿式步行鞋，鞋面看起来是弹力针织材质，后跟有一个小提环。鞋上没有鞋带，厚实的黑色鞋底侧面带有纹理。

B01AH00BLA.en: A gray slip-on walking shoe has a knit-looking upper with a perforated mesh pattern and small teal accents. It has no visible laces or buckle, and a thick white sole with textured detailing and a small teal section underneath.
B01AH00BLA.zh: 这是一只灰色的套穿式步行鞋，鞋面看起来是针织材质，带有网眼图案和少量蓝绿色细节。鞋面没有可见的鞋带或扣件，厚白色鞋底带有纹理，底部露出一小块蓝绿色部分。

B01AT3FA9I.en: A black, low-cut five-toe shoe has a mesh-like upper with red laces and a small black toggle. Its thin black sole has bright red sections visible beneath the toes and along the edge.
B01AT3FA9I.zh: 这是一只黑色低帮分趾鞋，鞋面看起来像网布，配有红色鞋带和一个小黑色扣件。鞋底较薄，主体为黑色，脚趾下方和边缘可见亮红色部分。

B01AMSKJ7S.en: A gray, low-cut slip-on shoe has a suede-like upper with a dark padded collar and a small fabric pull loop at the heel. It has no laces; a dark, thick rubber sole wraps up around the toe and heel, with an orange accent at the side.
B01AMSKJ7S.zh: 这是一只灰色低帮套穿鞋，鞋面看起来像绒面革，配有深色衬垫鞋口和后跟织物提环。鞋上没有鞋带；深色厚橡胶鞋底包覆鞋头和后跟，侧面带有橙色点缀。

B01BCQM9LI.en: A dark brown Western-style ankle boot has a creased, leather-like upper with stitched panels and two pull tabs at the top. It has no visible laces or other fastening, and a tan stacked-looking block heel with a thin tan-edged sole.
B01BCQM9LI.zh: 这是一只深棕色西部风格短靴，鞋面呈褶皱状、类似皮革，并有拼接缝线，靴口上方带有两个提拉袢。看不到鞋带或其他扣合装置；鞋跟为浅棕色层叠外观的方跟，鞋底边缘有一圈薄薄的浅棕色。

B01D3MS79W.en: A black open-toe slide sandal has a wide, smooth-looking synthetic strap across the foot, with no buckle or other fastening. Its black sole has a raised rim and a textured, dimpled footbed.
B01D3MS79W.zh: 这是一只黑色露趾一字拖，鞋面是一条宽阔、表面平滑的合成材质搭带，没有扣件或其他固定装置。黑色鞋底边缘略高，鞋床带有凹凸纹理。

B01CO1EVWK.en: A tan, ankle-high hiking boot with a suede-like upper, dark brown collar and tongue, and a dark toe bumper. Brown laces thread through metal hooks and eyelets, above a thick, rugged taupe sole with a dark tread.
B01CO1EVWK.zh: 这是一只棕褐色的高帮徒步靴，鞋面看起来像麂皮，配有深棕色鞋口和鞋舌，以及深色鞋头护边。棕色鞋带穿过金属挂钩和鞋眼，下方是厚实粗犷的灰褐色鞋底，底纹颜色较深。

B01D4ERLA0.en: This is a navy slip-on water shoe with a mesh upper, red stitching, and a multicoloured strip running down the front. It has a heel loop and no visible laces; the white sole has a textured, cutout pattern with black rubber sections.
B01D4ERLA0.zh: 这是一只深蓝色套穿式涉水鞋，网布鞋面带有红色缝线，前方有一条彩色饰带。鞋跟处有提环，没有可见鞋带；白色鞋底带有凹凸纹理和镂空图案，并有黑色橡胶部分。

B01DFP74Z0.en: A brown mid-height hiking boot with a dark rubber toe cap and tan accents. The upper looks like a mix of suede-like material and mesh, with fabric laces threaded through metal hooks and eyelets. It has a thick black lugged sole with a raised heel.
B01DFP74Z0.zh: 这是一只棕色中帮徒步靴，鞋头有深色橡胶包边，并带有棕褐色装饰。鞋面看起来由绒面质感材料和网布拼接而成，鞋带穿过金属挂钩和鞋眼。鞋底厚实、黑色，带有凸起的防滑齿纹和加高的后跟。

B01FH9BPP2.en: A beige wedge sandal with broad, smooth leather-like straps across the toes and instep. It has a small adjustable ankle strap with a buckle, and a thick cork-patterned wedge sole with a dark brown tread.
B01FH9BPP2.zh: 这是一款米 beige 色的坡跟凉鞋，鞋头和脚背处有宽大的光滑皮革质感带子。脚踝处有一条带扣的可调节搭带，厚坡跟呈软木纹理，底部是深棕色鞋底。

B01BF3WUP8.en: A dark navy low-top sneaker with a black mesh and synthetic-looking upper, navy laces, and light blue-gray stitching. It fastens with laces and has a thick gray midsole above a rugged black outsole with blue-gray tread blocks.
B01BF3WUP8.zh: 这是一只深海军蓝色低帮运动鞋，鞋面看起来由黑色网布和合成材质拼接而成，带有海军蓝鞋带和浅蓝灰色缝线。鞋带系合，灰色厚中底下方是带蓝灰色凸块的黑色粗纹外底。

B01FXKH2P2.en: A black low-top sneaker with a mesh toe and stitched suede-like and smooth panels, including a side panel with three circular details. It fastens with black laces and has a thick off-white midsole above a black ridged outsole.
B01FXKH2P2.zh: 这是一只黑色低帮运动鞋，鞋头为网布，鞋面有缝线装饰的麂皮质感和光滑拼接部分，侧面饰有三个圆形细节。鞋带为黑色，鞋底是厚实的米白色中底和黑色齿纹外底。

B01FSIKPNK.en: A dark navy, low-cut sneaker has a fine-textured, sparkly-looking fabric upper with darker overlays and elastic laces across the top. It has a pull tab at the heel and a thick, dark rubber sole with molded ridges and tread.
B01FSIKPNK.zh: 这是一只深海军蓝色的低帮运动鞋，鞋面为细纹理、带闪光感的织物，并有颜色较深的拼接片，鞋面上横跨着弹力鞋带。鞋跟处有提环，厚实的深色橡胶鞋底带有模压纹路和防滑纹。

B01GB41SBS.en: A dark gray flip-flop has a broad fabric strap with gray, black, and white woven stripes and a small gray tab. The strap joins between the toes, and the shoe has a thick, dark sole with a textured footbed.
B01GB41SBS.zh: 这是一只深灰色人字拖，宽布带上织有灰色、黑色和白色条纹，并带有一小块灰色饰片。鞋带从脚趾间连接，鞋底较厚且颜色较深，鞋床带有纹理。

B01FZLGAPW.en: A light gray and off-white running shoe with pale blue and yellow accents. Its upper appears to combine mesh and layered synthetic overlays, and it fastens with gray laces. The thick, rugged rubber sole has segmented sections in gray, white, and pale yellow.
B01FZLGAPW.zh: 这是一只浅灰色和米白色的跑鞋，带有淡蓝色和黄色点缀。鞋面看起来由网布和层叠的合成材料覆盖片组成，并以灰色鞋带系紧。厚实的橡胶鞋底凹凸分明，分为灰色、白色和淡黄色区块。

B01HEADW3A.en: A dark navy open-toe sandal with a gray footbed and a patterned gray fabric section across the upper. The upper has narrow straps and a padded heel strap, with a buckle fastening; the dark sole is thick and rugged with a wavy tread.
B01HEADW3A.zh: 这是一款深海军蓝色露趾凉鞋，配灰色鞋床和灰色花纹织物鞋面。鞋面有细带和加厚后跟带，以搭扣固定；深色鞋底较厚，底纹呈波浪状。

B01G2MV044.en: A closed-toe slipper in muted lavender, with a soft-looking suede upper and a thick cream-colored fleece lining around the opening. It has no visible fastening, and a dark, chunky rubber-looking sole with a ridged edge.
B01G2MV044.zh: 这是一只淡紫色的包头拖鞋，鞋面看起来像绒面革，鞋口周围露出厚实的奶油色绒毛内衬。没有可见的扣合装置，鞋底呈深色、厚实且边缘带有纹路。

B01HEADZSW.en: A dark gray thong sandal with a patterned footbed and a wide, stitched fabric upper that loops between the toes and across the top of the foot. It has no buckle or laces, and a thick black rubber sole with a ridged tread.
B01HEADZSW.zh: 这是一只深灰色夹趾凉鞋，鞋垫带有图案，宽幅织物鞋面有缝线，从脚趾间延伸并横跨脚背。鞋面没有扣带或鞋带，配有厚实的黑色橡胶鞋底，底面带有凹凸纹路。

B01HEAE1DA.en: A dark gray slide sandal with a molded footbed and several overlapping straps across the upper, made of smooth and patterned material with visible stitching. It has no buckle, and the dark sole is thick with a textured tread.
B01HEAE1DA.zh: 这是一只深灰色的一字拖凉鞋，鞋面由几条交叠的带子构成，带有光滑和纹样材质，并可见缝线；鞋床为模压造型。鞋面没有搭扣，深色鞋底较厚，底面带有纹路。

B01HEAE6GW.en: A black and dark gray water shoe has a mesh upper with textured overlays and bright orange-red accents. It fastens with black elastic laces and a toggle, and has a thick, rugged black and gray sole with orange-red details.
B01HEAE6GW.zh: 这是一只黑色与深灰色的涉水鞋，网布鞋面带有纹理叠层和亮橙红色点缀。鞋子用黑色弹力鞋带和扣件收紧，配有厚实、纹路明显的黑灰色鞋底，并带有橙红色细节。

B01HF9ZLNO.en: A dark gray mid-height hiking boot with black mesh panels and orange accents. The upper combines mesh and suede-like overlays, with black laces through fabric loops and hooks. It has a thick, rugged black-and-gray sole with deep tread.
B01HF9ZLNO.zh: 这是一只深灰色的中帮登山靴，带有黑色网布区域和橙色点缀。鞋面由网布和类似麂皮的拼片构成，黑色鞋带穿过布质鞋环和挂钩。厚实的黑灰色鞋底带有深纹路。

B01HF9ZNAA.en: A low-cut hiking shoe in taupe and gray, with a mesh upper, suede-like overlays, and a dark rubber toe cap. It fastens with dark laces threaded through fabric loops and eyelets, and has a thick, rugged black-and-gray sole with deep tread.
B01HF9ZNAA.zh: 这是一只低帮徒步鞋，呈灰褐色和灰色，鞋面为网布，并覆有绒面质感的拼片，鞋头带深色橡胶包边。鞋带穿过布环和鞋眼系紧，厚实的黑灰色鞋底带有深齿纹。

B01HF9ZN7I.en: A brown mid-height hiking boot with dark mesh panels and suede-like overlays, plus black protective edging around the toe. It fastens with orange-and-black laces through fabric loops and metal eyelets, and has a thick, rugged black sole with deep tread.
B01HF9ZN7I.zh: 这是一只棕色中帮徒步靴，带有深色网布拼片、绒面质感的覆盖层，以及包住鞋头的黑色防护边。橙黑相间的鞋带穿过织物鞋环和金属鞋孔，搭配厚实、带深纹路的黑色鞋底。

B01HGVY0TM.en: A mid-height hiking boot in dark brown and gray, with black mesh panels and purple-blue accents. The upper appears to combine suede-like material and mesh, with purple-blue laces threaded through fabric loops and hooks. It has a thick black and gray sole with deep, chunky tread.
B01HGVY0TM.zh: 这是一只中帮徒步靴，呈深棕色和灰色，带有黑色网布拼片及紫蓝色点缀。鞋面看起来由绒面质感材料和网布拼接而成，紫蓝色鞋带穿过织物鞋环和挂钩。鞋底厚实，呈黑灰色，带有深而粗大的纹路。

B01HSMYV8E.en: A gray running shoe has a mesh upper with darker gray stitched overlays and mint-green accents. It fastens with mint-green laces, and has a thick white sole with mint-green tread along the front and dark tread at the heel.
B01HSMYV8E.zh: 这是一只灰色跑鞋，网布鞋面搭配深灰色缝线覆片和薄荷绿点缀。鞋带为薄荷绿色；厚白色鞋底前部带薄荷绿色纹路，后跟处则有深色纹路。

B01HSM5RU0.en: A gray running shoe with a mesh upper, darker mesh panels, and lighter gray overlays. It fastens with gray laces, and has a thick white sole with a black treaded section underneath.
B01HSM5RU0.zh: 这是一只灰色跑鞋，鞋面为网布，搭配深色网布拼片和浅灰色覆层。鞋带为灰色，鞋底较厚、呈白色，底部可见黑色纹路部分。

B01IBZJ9IY.en: A white flat sandal with a tan footbed and stitched, cutout upper. It has an adjustable heel strap with a buckle, and a dark, slightly raised sole with visible stitching along the edge.
B01IBZJ9IY.zh: 这是一双白色平底凉鞋，配有棕褐色鞋垫和带镂空的缝线鞋面。后跟处有可调节的搭扣带，深色鞋底略微加厚，边缘可见缝线。

B01IB0KNHA.en: This is a slip-on boat shoe with a deep purple fabric-looking upper and tan panels across the vamp and around the collar. Purple-and-white laces thread through side loops, and contrast stitching outlines the upper; a thick, rounded white sole has a lightly ridged tread.
B01IB0KNHA.zh: 这是一款套穿式船鞋，鞋面看起来是深紫色织物，鞋背和鞋口周围有棕褐色拼片。紫白相间的鞋带穿过侧边环扣，鞋面边缘有撞色缝线；厚实圆润的白色鞋底带有浅浅的纹路。

B01IB0KKN2.en: A pale gold sandal has wide, woven-looking fabric straps across the toes and over the instep, with an adjustable buckle at the heel. It has a thick white wedge sole with a gray bottom and a gray footbed.
B01IB0KKN2.zh: 这是一只浅金色凉鞋，鞋头和脚背处有宽幅、外观似编织的布带，脚跟处配有可调节搭扣。鞋底是厚实的白色坡跟，底面为灰色，鞋床也是灰色。

B01ID9E9GU.en: A dark charcoal fisherman-style sandal has a closed toe and stitched, overlapping upper panels with a pebbled texture. A hook-and-loop strap fastens across the top, and the shoe has a thick, dark brown sole with a rounded edge.
B01ID9E9GU.zh: 这是一款深炭灰色的渔夫凉鞋，包头设计，鞋面由带有颗粒纹理的拼接面料层叠缝制而成。鞋面有一条粘扣带，厚实的深棕色鞋底边缘圆润。

B01IBZJA10.en: A white slide sandal has several broad, overlapping straps with stitched edges and oval cutouts. It slips on without a buckle, and has a tan footbed above a thick, black, slightly curved sole.
B01IBZJA10.zh: 这是一只白色一字拖凉鞋，鞋面由几条宽而交叠的带子组成，边缘有缝线，并带有椭圆形镂空。鞋子直接套穿，没有搭扣；棕褐色鞋垫下方是厚实、略带弧度的黑色鞋底。

B01IIPVTGC.en: A black flip-flop with a dark gray, fabric-textured V-shaped upper and a small logo. It slips on with a toe post and has a thick black sole with a textured, ridged bottom.
B01IIPVTGC.zh: 这是一只黑色人字拖，V形鞋面呈深灰色，带有织物纹理和小标志。鞋子通过夹趾柱穿着，配有厚实的黑色鞋底，底面带纹路。

B01J2RZYXY.en: A dark navy slip-on sneaker has a knitted-looking fabric upper and a low, rounded toe. It has no visible laces or straps, and a thick light-gray sole with a textured, ridged tread.
B01J2RZYXY.zh: 这是一只深藏青色的套穿式运动鞋，鞋面看起来像针织面料，鞋头低矮圆润。鞋面没有可见的鞋带或搭扣，配有厚实的浅灰色鞋底，底面纹路凸起。

B01L2RRBME.en: A dark gray flip-flop sandal has a brown, leather-like upper with a toe post and a wide strap across the foot. It has no buckle or other fastener; the dark sole is thick, with a slightly raised edge.
B01L2RRBME.zh: 这是一只深灰色人字拖，棕色皮革质感的鞋面带有夹趾柱和横跨脚面的宽带。鞋面没有搭扣或其他扣合装置；深色鞋底较厚，边缘略微隆起。

B01L99SW78.en: A brown mid-calf Western boot with a suede-like leather upper, burgundy stitched patterns, and pull tabs at the top. It has no laces or visible closure, and a thick black sole with a low heel and chunky tread.
B01L99SW78.zh: 这是一款棕色中筒西部风格靴，鞋面看起来像绒面皮革，并饰有酒红色缝线图案，靴口带有提拉环。靴子没有鞋带或可见的闭合装置，配有厚实的黑色鞋底、低鞋跟和粗纹路鞋底。

B01M0W56E4.en: A dark gray and black trail running shoe has a mesh upper with gray and coral-pink accents. It fastens with black laces, and its thick gray sole has black sections and coral-pink tread.
B01M0W56E4.zh: 这是一只深灰色和黑色的越野跑鞋，网布鞋面带有灰色和珊瑚粉色装饰。鞋带为黑色，厚实的灰色鞋底配有黑色部分和珊瑚粉色外底纹路。

B01MD1K6SC.en: A brown leather-looking Oxford shoe has a rounded toe with decorative perforations and wingtip-style stitching. It fastens with brown laces, and has a low, dark sole with a brown band at the heel.
B01MD1K6SC.zh: 这是一只棕色、外观似皮革的牛津鞋，圆头饰有镂孔和翼纹缝线。鞋面以棕色鞋带系合，鞋底较低且颜色较深，鞋跟处有一圈棕色层。

B01M21RHUO.en: A black low-top sneaker has a textured fabric upper and a white rubber toe cap. It fastens with black elastic laces, and has a thick, flat white sole with a narrow dark strip along the bottom.
B01M21RHUO.zh: 这是一只黑色低帮运动鞋，鞋面看起来是有纹理的织物，鞋头覆有白色橡胶。鞋面以黑色弹力鞋带固定，搭配厚实平直的白色鞋底，底部边缘有一条窄窄的深色线。

B01M17LSEE.en: A white and light-gray athletic training shoe has a layered synthetic-looking upper with dark-gray accents and bright-green details. It fastens with white laces, and its thick white sole has a dark rubber tread underneath and at the heel.
B01M17LSEE.zh: 这是一只白色和浅灰色的运动训练鞋，鞋面看起来由层叠的合成材料制成，配有深灰色饰片和亮绿色细节。鞋带为白色；厚实的白色鞋底在底部和后跟处带有深色橡胶纹路。

B01MAY8YTA.en: A brown open-toe sandal with a stitched, leather-like upper and padded straps. Three hook-and-loop straps fasten across the forefoot, instep, and heel; it has a thick, black, ridged rubber-looking sole.
B01MAY8YTA.zh: 这是一只棕色露趾凉鞋，鞋面看起来像皮革，带有缝线和加厚鞋带。三条粘扣带分别横跨前脚掌、脚背和脚跟；鞋底厚实、黑色，外观带有纹路。

B01MDJ3FW5.en: A low-top sneaker with a dark gray and black camouflage-patterned fabric upper and frayed edges. It has metal eyelets with no laces visible, a small brown side tab, and a thick white rubber sole with a textured toe bumper.
B01MDJ3FW5.zh: 这是一双低帮运动鞋，鞋面为深灰色和黑色迷彩图案布料，边缘带有毛边。鞋带孔是金属的，未见鞋带，侧面有一小块棕色饰片；厚白色橡胶鞋底的鞋头部分带有纹理。

B01MQKBHVJ.en: A dark brown casual sneaker with a fabric-and-suede-looking upper, mesh panels, and matching laces. It fastens with laces and has a thick, dark rubber sole with raised oval and textured details.
B01MQKBHVJ.zh: 这是一只深棕色休闲运动鞋，鞋面看起来由织物和绒面材料制成，并带有网布拼片和同色鞋带。鞋带用于系紧，厚实的深色橡胶鞋底带有凸起的椭圆形和纹理细节。

B01MRV2PB9.en: A gray slip-on slipper has a suede-like upper and a thick, fluffy gray lining around the opening. It has no visible fastener and a dark, chunky rubber sole with deep tread.
B01MRV2PB9.zh: 这是一只灰色套穿式拖鞋，鞋面看起来像绒面革，鞋口围着厚实蓬松的灰色绒毛。没有可见的扣合件，深色厚橡胶鞋底带有明显的凹凸纹路。

B01MRZPT9E.en: A black closed-toe pump with a smooth, slightly glossy leather-like upper and a strap across the instep that fastens with a small buckle. It has a thick, low block heel and a black sole with a shallow tread.
B01MRZPT9E.zh: 这是一只黑色包头浅口鞋，鞋面光滑，带有些许光泽，质感像皮革；鞋背上有一条搭带，以小扣环固定。鞋跟为厚实的低方跟，黑色鞋底带有浅纹路。

B01MYGURYK.en: A navy running shoe with a dark mesh upper, coral-pink laces and accents, and a padded tongue. It fastens with laces, and has a thick white sole with coral-pink tread and trim.
B01MYGURYK.zh: 这是一只海军蓝跑鞋，鞋面为深色网布，配有珊瑚粉色鞋带和点缀，鞋舌带有衬垫。鞋带系合，厚实的白色鞋底带有珊瑚粉色的鞋底纹路和边饰。

B01MYUCJBF.en: A black slip-on fitness shoe with a textured knit upper and a raised heel tab. It has no visible laces or buckle, and a thick black sole with curved grooves and a slightly raised heel.
B01MYUCJBF.zh: 这是一只黑色套穿式运动鞋，鞋面呈织物纹理，后跟有一个凸起的提环。看不到鞋带或扣件，黑色鞋底较厚，带有弧形凹槽，后跟略微加高。

B01N28J1LK.en: A tan thong sandal has narrow white straps with dark trim and a small silver-tone buckle on the backstrap. It has a tan footbed and a dark brown sole with a gently raised heel.
B01N28J1LK.zh: 这是一款棕褐色夹趾凉鞋，细白色鞋带带有深色饰边，后跟带配有一枚小银色扣。鞋床为棕褐色，深棕色鞋底的后跟略微加高。

B01MU2XM13.en: A dark brown and black trail-style shoe with orange accents, featuring a mesh and synthetic-looking upper with reinforced overlays. It fastens with orange-flecked black laces, and has a thick, rugged tan-and-black treaded sole with small orange details.
B01MU2XM13.zh: 这是一只深棕色和黑色、带橙色点缀的越野风格鞋，鞋面看起来由网布和合成材料制成，并有加固覆层。鞋带为带橙色点缀的黑色鞋带；厚实的棕褐色与黑色鞋底带有粗犷纹路和少量橙色细节。

B01N370RME.en: A black flat sandal has bright turquoise braided straps forming a thong between the toes, with black-and-white braided straps crossing over the foot. It has a dark, smooth footbed with white stitching around the edge and no visible buckle or closure.
B01N370RME.zh: 这是一只黑色平底凉鞋，亮 turquoise 色编织带在脚趾间形成人字夹式结构，黑白编织带交叉覆盖脚面。鞋床颜色较深、表面光滑，边缘有白色缝线，未见搭扣或其他闭合装置。

B01N64EM3S.en: A black slide sandal has a wide, smooth-looking synthetic strap with three white stripes and a textured surface. It slips on with no fastener, and has a thick black sole with ridged sides and a textured footbed.
B01N64EM3S.zh: 这是一只黑色拖鞋，宽鞋带看起来由光滑的合成材料制成，带有三道白色条纹和纹理。它无需扣件，直接穿入，配有厚实的黑色鞋底、带棱纹的侧面和有纹理的鞋床。

B01N2GM1SM.en: A low-cut hiking shoe in charcoal gray, with blue accents and a dark mesh upper reinforced by synthetic-looking overlays. Blue-gray laces fasten through fabric loops, and the thick black rubber sole has deep, rugged tread with a light gray section at the heel.
B01N2GM1SM.zh: 这是一只低帮徒步鞋，鞋面为炭灰色，带蓝色点缀；深色网布鞋面配有看似合成材质的加固片。蓝灰色鞋带穿过织物鞋环系紧，厚黑色橡胶鞋底带有深而粗犷的纹路，后跟处有一段浅灰色部分。

B01N5MV6DU.en: A dark charcoal-grey casual sneaker has a moc-toe shape and a textured fabric-looking upper with contrast stitching. It fastens with dark laces threaded through brown loops, and has a thick, smooth white sole.
B01N5MV6DU.zh: 这是一只深炭灰色的休闲运动鞋，鞋头呈莫卡辛鞋样式，鞋面看起来有织物质感，并带有对比色缝线。鞋带为深色，穿过棕色鞋眼固定；鞋底厚实、平滑，呈白色。

B01ND4DEH1.en: A brown slip-on hiking shoe with a suede-like upper and darker mesh around the collar. It has no laces, and a thick, rugged black rubber sole with brown sections underneath.
B01ND4DEH1.zh: 这是一只棕色套脚式徒步鞋，鞋面看起来像麂皮，鞋口周围是较深色的网布。鞋面没有鞋带，底部是厚实、纹路粗犷的黑色橡胶鞋底，底面带有棕色部分。

B01N6X05E6.en: A low-cut sneaker with a black-and-gray patterned knit-looking upper and black trim. It has black elastic straps across the top and a thick, dark gray textured rubber sole.
B01N6X05E6.zh: 这是一款低帮运动鞋，鞋面呈黑灰相间的纹理，像针织材质，并带有黑色饰边。鞋面上有黑色弹性带，搭配厚实的深灰色纹理橡胶鞋底。

B01NBAULY4.en: A purple running shoe with bright coral-orange accents and a large white side stripe. The upper looks like breathable mesh with overlay panels and fabric laces; the sole is thick, with a white middle section and an orange-and-purple treaded bottom.
B01NBAULY4.zh: 这是一只紫色跑鞋，带有亮珊瑚橙色装饰和醒目的白色侧边条纹。鞋面看起来是透气网布，覆有拼接片，并以布鞋带系紧；鞋底较厚，中层为白色，底部带有橙色和紫色的纹路。

B06XB5Q3H3.en: A dark navy, open-toe slide sandal with a broad molded upper and a silver logo. It slips on without a fastening, and has a thick, contoured dark sole with a raised heel and textured sides.
B06XB5Q3H3.zh: 这是一只深海军蓝色的露趾拖鞋，宽大的鞋面为模压造型，饰有银色标志。它无需扣合，直接穿入；深色鞋底厚实且有弧度，后跟略高，侧面带有纹理。

B06XRTPG99.en: A dark brown clog with a rounded toe and small ventilation holes across the upper, which looks like molded plastic. A broad strap crosses the top and attaches at the sides; the thick sole has a textured, ridged edge.
B06XRTPG99.zh: 这是一只深棕色圆头木屐鞋，鞋面看起来是模压塑料，前部有许多透气孔。一条宽带横跨鞋面并连接在两侧；厚鞋底边缘带有纹理和凸棱。

B06XD4V6RD.en: A red slip-on loafer has a textured upper with cutout openings and narrow straps across the top. It has no visible fastening, and a thick tan sole with rounded tread bumps underneath.
B06XD4V6RD.zh: 这是一只红色套穿式乐福鞋，鞋面带有纹理，前部有镂空和横跨鞋面的细带。看不到明显的系扣，鞋底较厚，呈棕褐色，底部有圆形凸纹。

B06Y6JDN2P.en: A dark navy slide sandal has a single wide, textured strap over the foot, with a small white logo on the side; it slips on with no buckle or laces. Its thick, matching navy sole has a raised heel and a gently curved shape.
B06Y6JDN2P.zh: 这是一只深海军蓝色的一字拖凉鞋，鞋面有一条宽而带纹理的横带，侧面有小型白色标志；没有搭扣或鞋带，直接套穿。鞋底厚实，与鞋面同为海军蓝色，后跟略高，整体呈柔和弧形。

B06XPFG2HK.en: A black ballet flat has a rounded toe and a low-cut opening, with a finely ribbed, knit-looking upper. It has no visible fastening, and a thin, flat black sole with a slight heel.
B06XPFG2HK.zh: 这是一只黑色芭蕾平底鞋，鞋头圆润，鞋口较低，鞋面看起来是细密罗纹针织材质。没有可见的扣合装置，鞋底薄而平，带有微微隆起的鞋跟。

B071GMY3BC.en: A white low-top athletic sneaker with turquoise side panels and small turquoise accents. The upper appears to be smooth synthetic material with perforated sections, and it fastens with white laces. Its thick white and gray sole has turquoise sections at the heel.
B071GMY3BC.zh: 这是一只白色低帮运动鞋，带有蓝绿色侧面拼片和小面积蓝绿色点缀。鞋面看起来是光滑的合成材料，部分区域有透气孔，并以白色鞋带系紧。厚鞋底由白色和灰色部分组成，后跟处带有蓝绿色区域。

B06XTCJ285.en: A gray slip-on ballet flat has a printed upper with dark animal silhouettes and bright pink accents, made of what looks like fabric. It has no visible fastener and a low, dark rubber-like sole.
B06XTCJ285.zh: 这是一只灰色套穿式芭蕾平底鞋，布面上印有深色动物剪影和亮粉色点缀。看不到扣件，鞋底低矮，呈深色橡胶质感。

B071JMD8NJ.en: A black and mint-green running shoe with a mesh upper and dark synthetic overlays. It fastens with black laces and has a thick white midsole above a black-and-mint treaded outsole.
B071JMD8NJ.zh: 这是一只黑色和薄荷绿相间的跑鞋，鞋面为网布，并带有深色合成材料覆层。鞋带为黑色，底部是厚实的白色中底和黑色、薄荷绿相间的纹路外底。

B071L2FXWD.en: A charcoal-gray, mid-calf slip-on boot with a rounded toe and a soft-looking suede upper. It has no visible fastening, and the thick dark sole has a ridged tread.
B071L2FXWD.zh: 这是一只炭灰色的中筒套穿靴，鞋头圆润，鞋面看起来像柔软的麂皮。没有可见的扣合结构，厚实的深色鞋底带有凹凸纹路。

B071JMDR6D.en: A trail-running shoe with a black, gray, and bright blue woven-mesh upper, reinforced by black overlays and a silver side detail. It fastens with blue-and-black laces and has a thick black sole with deep, chunky lavender-blue tread.
B071JMDR6D.zh: 这是一只越野跑鞋，鞋面为黑色、灰色和亮蓝色的编织网布，并有黑色补强饰片和银色侧面装饰。鞋带为蓝黑相间，鞋底厚实、呈黑色，带有深而粗大的淡紫蓝色纹路。

B071RG3CCH.en: A brown slip-on loafer with a rounded toe and a perforated leather-looking upper, finished with visible stitching around the toe. It has no laces or buckle, and a low black rubber-looking sole with segmented tread.
B071RG3CCH.zh: 这是一只棕色套穿式乐福鞋，圆头，鞋面看起来像皮革，并带有透气孔，鞋头边缘有明显的缝线。鞋子没有鞋带或搭扣，配有低矮的黑色鞋底，底部带分段纹路。

B071RB9GW7.en: A dark green clog-style sandal has a closed, rounded toe and a perforated upper that appears to be molded plastic or rubber. It slips on without a visible fastening, and has a thick, dark green sole with a thin light-colored stripe around the side.
B071RB9GW7.zh: 这是一只深绿色的包头洞洞凉鞋，鞋面布满圆孔，看起来像模压塑料或橡胶材质。鞋子没有可见的扣合装置，配有厚实的深绿色鞋底，侧边环绕着一条浅色细线。

B071WW77CD.en: A black flip-flop sandal with multicoloured woven fabric straps and a toe post. It has a thick, black, contoured sole with a ridged edge.
B071WW77CD.zh: 一只黑色人字拖凉鞋，带有多色编织布面带和夹趾柱。鞋底厚实、呈黑色弧形，边缘带有纹路。

B071S8CS84.en: A coral-red flip-flop has a black, textured strap with pink edging and a white logo. The strap passes between the toes and across the foot, and the shoe has a thick, curved black sole with a ridged underside.
B071S8CS84.zh: 这是一只珊瑚红色的人字拖，配有黑色纹理鞋带、粉色滚边和白色标志。鞋带从脚趾间穿过并横跨脚背，鞋底厚实、弯曲，黑色底面带有纹路。

B071VCTK8W.en: A low-cut aqua shoe has a light gray mesh upper with darker gray panels and multicolored accents. Black elastic laces pass through fabric loops and tighten with a cord lock; the thick white sole has a dark gray rim and sculpted tread.
B071VCTK8W.zh: 这是一只低帮水上鞋，鞋面为浅灰色网布，搭配深灰色部件和彩色细节。黑色弹力鞋带穿过织物环，并用绳扣收紧；厚白色鞋底带有深灰色边沿和起伏的纹路。

B07238F48K.en: A black slip-on skate shoe has a ribbed, fabric-looking upper with an orange logo on the tongue. It has no visible laces or other fastener, and a thick, white rubber sole.
B07238F48K.zh: 这是一只黑色一脚蹬滑板鞋，鞋面看起来是带罗纹的织物，鞋舌上有橙色标志。鞋面没有可见的鞋带或其他扣合装置，搭配厚实的白色橡胶鞋底。

B0721MPCKL.en: A black low-cut lace-up shoe with a smooth, slightly textured leather-like upper and small perforations on the side. It has a thick, black rubber-looking sole with a raised heel.
B0721MPCKL.zh: 这是一只黑色低帮系带鞋，鞋面看起来像光滑且略带纹理的皮革，侧面有细小的透气孔。鞋底厚实，呈黑色，外观像橡胶，后跟略高。

B072KTJFPB.en: A pale blush-pink, round-toe pump with a smooth upper and decorative pierced cutouts along the side. A narrow strap with a round buckle fastens across the instep; it has a slim mid-height heel and a thin dark-edged sole.
B072KTJFPB.zh: 这是一只浅粉色圆头高跟鞋，鞋面光滑，侧面有装饰性的镂空。鞋面横跨脚背的细带用圆形搭扣固定；鞋跟细而中等高度，鞋底边缘呈深色。

B073T364MM.en: A gold, low-cut ballet flat with a rounded-square toe and a glittery-looking upper. It has no visible fastening, and a thin tan sole with a low heel.
B073T364MM.zh: 这是一只金色低口芭蕾平底鞋，鞋头呈圆方形，鞋面看起来带有闪粉。没有可见的搭扣，鞋底为薄薄的棕褐色，后跟较低。

B073TN9575.en: A black pointed-toe flat with a smooth-looking upper, an open D’Orsay side, and a slim dark sole. A narrow ankle strap with a small buckle fastens around the ankle.
B073TN9575.zh: 这是一款黑色尖头平底鞋，鞋面看起来光滑，侧面敞开呈浅口设计，配有纤薄的深色鞋底。细踝带通过一枚小扣环固定。

B0725CMWD4.en: This is a flat sandal with a dark gray footbed and sole, edged with white stitching. The upper has light turquoise braided straps mixed with dark brown straps, with tassel-like details; it slips on with no visible buckle or fastening.
B0725CMWD4.zh: 这是一款平底凉鞋，深灰色鞋床和鞋底边缘缝有白色线迹。鞋面由浅绿松石色编织带和深棕色鞋带交错组成，并带有流苏状装饰；看不到搭扣或其他固定装置。

B073XLK7FF.en: This is a sandal with a tan footbed and two silvery-gray, suede-like straps across the upper, each fastened with a dark buckle. It has a thick brown cork-look midsole and a white, ridged outsole.
B073XLK7FF.zh: 这是一款凉鞋，棕褐色鞋床上有两条银灰色、绒面质感的鞋带，每条都用深色搭扣固定。鞋底中层厚实，呈棕色软木质感，底面为白色并带有凹凸纹路。

B07487KLPH.en: A reddish-brown Oxford shoe with a glossy, leather-like upper, decorative brogue perforations, and a rounded toe. It fastens with matching laces and has a thick black sole with a tall block heel.
B07487KLPH.zh: 这是一只红棕色牛津鞋，鞋面呈亮面皮革质感，带有布洛克式镂空装饰和圆头。鞋带与鞋面同色，鞋底厚实且为黑色，后跟是高方跟。

B074HHJYGW.en: A pink open-toe house slipper has a broad, softly textured fabric band across the front, with a pale pink-and-white striped fabric footbed. It slips on without a fastener and has a thin, light-colored sole with a fabric-covered edge.
B074HHJYGW.zh: 这是一只粉色露趾家居拖鞋，前部有一条宽大的柔软织物鞋面，鞋床为浅粉色和白色条纹织物。它无需扣合，直接套穿，底部是薄薄的浅色鞋底，边缘包有织物。

B07535XTZP.en: A slip-on walking shoe with a blue, teal, and gray woven-knit upper and a dark interior. It has no laces or visible fastener, and a thick white sole with a ridged, scalloped-looking tread.
B07535XTZP.zh: 这是一款套穿式步行鞋，鞋面为蓝色、青绿色和灰色的编织针织材质，内里颜色较深。鞋上没有鞋带或可见的扣合装置，配有厚实的白色鞋底，底部边缘呈凹凸波浪状。

B074PR7GYV.en: A metallic taupe slide sandal has several wide straps across the foot, with hook-and-loop tabs for fastening. The upper looks like smooth synthetic material, and it has a thick, dark, molded sole with a ridged tread underneath.
B074PR7GYV.zh: 这是一只金属光泽灰褐色的套脚凉鞋，鞋面有几条宽带，并以粘扣带固定。鞋面看起来是光滑的合成材料，配有厚实的深色模压鞋底，底部带有纹路。

B0753J399N.en: A black slide sandal has a wide, textured synthetic-looking strap with a red logo and an open toe. It slips on without a buckle, and its black sole has a textured footbed and a ridged edge.
B0753J399N.zh: 这是一只黑色一字拖，宽鞋面带有纹理，看起来像合成材料，并印有红色标志，鞋头敞开。它无需搭扣，直接套脚穿着；黑色鞋底带有纹理鞋床和凹凸边缘。

B074P1XR97.en: A black thong sandal with a broad, textured upper strap and a small cutout detail. The strap loops between the toes, and the thick black sole has a gently contoured shape.
B074P1XR97.zh: 这是一只黑色人字拖，宽鞋带表面带有纹理，并有一处小镂空细节。鞋带从脚趾间穿过，厚实的黑色鞋底轮廓略带弧度。

B07568JYPN.en: A low-top casual sneaker has a light taupe knit-mesh toe and tongue, with darker gray mesh around the ankle and tan suede-like side panels with small perforations. Gray elastic laces cross the top, and a broad light-gray sole has a dark, ridged tread underneath.
B07568JYPN.zh: 这是一双低帮休闲运动鞋，鞋头和鞋舌为浅褐灰色针织网布，脚踝处为深灰网布，侧面有带小孔的棕褐色绒面质感拼片。灰色弹力鞋带交叉穿过鞋面，宽大的浅灰色鞋底下方带有深色凹凸纹路。

B0756YW7BH.en: A dark gray slip-on loafer with a textured fabric upper and darker suede-like panels around the sides and heel. It has no laces, and the thick gray rubber sole has a darker stripe and shallow grooves.
