B0756YW7BH.zh: 这是一只深灰色套穿式便鞋，鞋面为有纹理的织物，侧面和后跟处有颜色更深、类似麂皮的拼接。鞋上没有鞋带，厚实的灰色橡胶鞋底带有深色条纹和浅槽纹。

B075GFLMFC.en: A black Mary Jane flat has a rounded toe and an upper combining smooth, subtly textured panels with mesh sections. A wide strap fastens across the instep with a hook-and-loop closure, above a thick black sole with a gently curved edge.
B075GFLMFC.zh: 这是一双黑色玛丽珍平底鞋，圆头鞋面结合了光滑、带细微纹理的拼片和网眼部分。宽鞋带横过脚背，以粘扣带固定，下方是边缘微微弯曲的厚黑色鞋底。

B0762FM6ZN.en: A low-top white sneaker with dark navy side stripes and a padded gray collar. The upper appears to be smooth leather, with perforations at the toe, and it fastens with white laces. A thick, flat white rubber sole has a lightly textured edge.
B0762FM6ZN.zh: 这是一款白色低帮运动鞋，带有深海军蓝侧条纹和灰色加垫鞋口。鞋面看起来是光滑皮革，鞋头有透气孔，并用白色鞋带系紧。厚实平坦的白色橡胶鞋底边缘带有细微纹理。

B075XJC2D9.en: A taupe-brown ankle-high hiking boot has a smooth, suede-like upper, darker brown padded collar, and tan accent panels. It fastens with brown laces through metal eyelets, above a thick cream-colored lugged sole with a tan strip along the edge.
B075XJC2D9.zh: 这是一只灰褐色的高帮徒步靴，鞋面看起来光滑、像绒面革，配有深棕色软垫鞋口和棕黄色拼接饰片。棕色鞋带穿过金属鞋眼系紧，下方是厚实的奶油色齿纹鞋底，边缘带有棕黄色条纹。

B0772R1LRL.en: A black, glossy T-strap Oxford-style shoe has a square toe and a smooth-looking upper with perforated trim. It fastens with a buckle at the side, and has a thick, ridged platform sole with a chunky block heel.
B0772R1LRL.zh: 这是一只黑色亮面 T 字带牛津风鞋，方头，鞋面看起来光滑，并饰有穿孔边饰。鞋侧以搭扣固定，配有厚实的凹槽防滑厚底和粗跟。

B076HY8LM7.en: A low-top sneaker with a light gray, textured fabric upper and matching gray laces threaded through metal eyelets. It has an off-white rubber sole with a rounded toe and a narrow raised edge.
B076HY8LM7.zh: 这是一只低帮运动鞋，浅灰色纹理布面配同色鞋带，鞋带穿过金属鞋眼。鞋底为米白色橡胶，鞋头圆润，边缘略微凸起。

B076JJ8N5F.en: A beige sport sandal has a tan footbed and pale cream fabric straps with a woven pattern. The straps cross over the toes and fasten with a wide hook-and-loop strap over the instep; a thick tan sole has a textured, wavy side and a ridged tread.
B076JJ8N5F.zh: 这是一款米色运动凉鞋，配有棕褐色鞋床和带编织图案的浅奶油色布质鞋带。鞋带在脚趾上方交叉，并以一条宽大的魔术贴带固定在脚背上；厚实的棕褐色鞋底侧面有波浪纹，底部带有凹凸纹路。

B076DFN3P7.en: A tall brown over-the-knee boot with a suede-like, napped upper and a pointed toe. A side zipper is visible, and it has a thin dark sole with a high, block-shaped heel.
B076DFN3P7.zh: 这是一只棕色过膝长靴，鞋面呈绒面质感，鞋头尖圆。侧面可见拉链，配有深色薄鞋底和高方跟。

B077Y1NXD6.en: A black trail-running shoe with a mesh and synthetic-looking upper, patterned with gray and white panels and coral-red accents. Coral-red patterned laces fasten it, and the thick black sole has deep, chunky gray-and-black tread lugs.
B077Y1NXD6.zh: 这是一只黑色越野跑鞋，鞋面看起来由网布和合成材料制成，搭配灰白色图案拼片和珊瑚红色细节。鞋带为带图案的珊瑚红色，厚实的黑色鞋底带有深而粗大的灰黑色齿纹。

B077YBMLFH.en: A dark navy trail-running shoe with light blue and gray accents, a mesh upper reinforced with synthetic overlays, and a large outlined “N” on the side. It fastens with blue-and-black laces and has a thick black sole with deep, rugged tread.
B077YBMLFH.zh: 这是一只深海军蓝色的越野跑鞋，带有浅蓝和灰色细节；鞋面为网布材质，并有合成材料覆层加固，侧面有醒目的描边“N”标志。鞋带为蓝黑相间，鞋底厚实、呈黑色，带有深而粗犷的纹路。

B078GSXGWZ.en: A light gray slip-on walking sneaker has a finely textured mesh-like upper and a rounded toe. It has no visible laces, and its thick white sole has a gently scalloped bottom edge.
B078GSXGWZ.zh: 这是一双浅灰色一脚蹬步行运动鞋，鞋面呈细密网布状纹理，鞋头圆润。鞋面没有可见鞋带，厚实的白色鞋底边缘带有柔和的波浪形凹凸。

B077ZWVCQT.en: A tan sandal has a perforated, suede-like upper with a toe post and an adjustable buckle ankle strap. It has a light beige footbed and a dark brown, low-profile sole.
B077ZWVCQT.zh: 这是一只棕褐色凉鞋，鞋面呈麂皮质感并带有镂空孔眼，配有夹趾柱和可调节的踝带扣。浅米色鞋床下方是深棕色的低矮鞋底。

B077X5CH8F.en: A burgundy slip-on clog with a smooth, molded-looking upper and a dark burgundy fuzzy lining folded around the opening; it has no fastener. The thick burgundy sole has a patterned sidewall and raised tread underneath.
B077X5CH8F.zh: 这是一只酒红色的一脚蹬木屐鞋，鞋面看起来光滑且为一体成型，鞋口翻出深酒红色绒毛内衬；没有搭扣或其他扣合装置。厚实的酒红色鞋底侧面带有纹路，底部有凸起的防滑纹。

B078GPLYJB.en: A slip-on loafer-style shoe in mottled brown and tan, with a woven-looking textile upper and visible stitching around the raised front panel. It has no laces or other visible fastening, and a dark, thick sole with a thin light-colored strip along the bottom.
B078GPLYJB.zh: 这是一只棕色与浅褐色相间的套脚便鞋，鞋面看起来像编织纺织布，前部凸起面片周围可见缝线。鞋上没有鞋带或其他可见的固定装置，深色厚鞋底底边带有一条浅色细边。

B078HD5ZQK.en: A black strappy sandal has a tan footbed and a closed heel strap. Its textured fabric-like upper fastens with three small buckles, and the sole is thick and white with a gently raised heel.
B078HD5ZQK.zh: 这是一款黑色多带凉鞋，配有棕褐色鞋垫和包住脚跟的后带。纹理上层看起来像织物，以三个小搭扣固定；鞋底较厚、呈白色，后跟略微抬高。

B078HGYHPQ.en: A brown slip-on shoe with a moc-toe seam and a broad flap across the instep. The upper looks like suede or nubuck, with no visible laces or buckle; a dark brown sole has a raised reddish-brown sidewall with white stitching.
B078HGYHPQ.zh: 这是一只棕色套穿鞋，鞋头有莫卡辛式缝线，鞋面中部覆有宽片。鞋面看起来像绒面革或磨砂皮，没有可见的鞋带或搭扣；深棕色鞋底配有略微凸起的红棕色侧边，并带白色缝线。

B078HDBP3C.en: A dark charcoal flip-flop has a black woven toe post and glossy mottled brown straps with a small metal accent. It slips on without a buckle, and has a thick, dark sole with a slightly raised heel and textured footbed.
B078HDBP3C.zh: 这是一只深炭灰色人字拖，带有黑色编织夹趾带和带光泽、棕色斑驳纹理的鞋带，饰有小金属装饰。鞋子无需扣带，配有较厚的深色鞋底、略高的后跟和带纹理的鞋床。

B078WH536F.en: A black low-cut athletic walking shoe with a mesh-looking upper and black lace-up fastening. It has a thick black sole with a rounded toe and a ridged, segmented-looking underside.
B078WH536F.zh: 这是一只黑色低帮运动休闲鞋，鞋面看起来是网布材质，采用黑色鞋带系合。鞋底较厚，鞋头圆润，底部带有分段状纹路。

B079BVLDPV.en: A pale blue slip-on slide sandal has a wide, molded upper with small raised dots and open sides. It has no fastening, and the flat-looking sole has round drainage holes across the footbed and heel.
B079BVLDPV.zh: 这是一只浅蓝色的一脚蹬拖鞋，宽大的模压鞋面带有细小凸点，两侧敞开。鞋子没有搭扣，外观看起来较平的鞋底在脚床和后跟处布满圆形排水孔。

B07B21Q2CJ.en: A brown suede mule slipper has an open back and a wide cream-colored fluffy collar around the heel. It has no visible fastening, and the tan sole is thick with deep ridged treads.
B07B21Q2CJ.zh: 这是一只棕色绒面穆勒拖鞋，后跟敞开，鞋口周围有一圈宽宽的奶油色绒毛。鞋面没有可见的固定扣，浅棕色鞋底较厚，带有深凹槽纹路。

B0798KVB4Y.en: A black athletic running shoe has a textured knit-like upper, gray laces, a large white-outlined N on the side, and a heather-gray heel section. Its thick white sole has a dimpled texture and a thin gum-brown strip along the bottom.
B0798KVB4Y.zh: 这是一只黑色运动跑鞋，鞋面呈织物针织般的纹理，配有灰色鞋带，侧面有白色描边的大号 N 标志，后跟部分为灰色混色纹理。厚实的白色鞋底带有凹凸纹理，底边还有一条细窄的棕色橡胶色条。

B07B9S5YLH.en: A dark gray ankle boot with a soft, suede-like upper and a fluffy fur trim around the opening. It has no visible laces or buckle, and a thick, dark sole with a rounded toe and textured tread.
B07B9S5YLH.zh: 这是一只深灰色的短筒靴，鞋面看起来像柔软的麂皮，靴口围着蓬松的毛绒饰边。鞋面看不到鞋带或扣环，搭配厚实的深色鞋底、圆头和带纹理的底纹。

B07B6L1SNW.en: A gray mid-height hiking boot with a suede-like upper, black toe and heel trim, and orange accents. It fastens with gray-and-orange laces through metal hooks and eyelets, above a thick white midsole and a chunky black treaded outsole with orange sections.
B07B6L1SNW.zh: 这是一只灰色中帮登山靴，鞋面看起来像绒面革，鞋头和后跟有黑色饰边，并带有橙色点缀。鞋带为灰色和橙色相间，穿过金属钩和鞋眼；鞋底有厚白色中底，以及带橙色部分的厚实黑色齿纹外底。

B07BHW6KX6.en: A flat sandal with a tan footbed and beige woven elastic straps crossing the toes and wrapping around the heel. It has an open toe and back, and a thin, dark-edged flat sole.
B07BHW6KX6.zh: 这是一款平底凉鞋，棕褐色鞋垫上有米色编织弹力带，带子横过脚趾并绕住脚跟。鞋头和后跟敞开，鞋底薄而平，边缘颜色较深。

B07B5RGY2N.en: A low-top sneaker in dusty pinkish-tan fabric, with stitched panels and a small patterned patch at the heel. It fastens with tan laces through dark metal eyelets, with a short zipper on the outer side, and has a thick white rubber sole with vertical ridges around the edge.
B07B5RGY2N.zh: 这是一只低帮运动鞋，鞋面为灰调粉棕色织物，带有拼接缝线，鞋跟处有一小块图案布料。鞋带穿过深色金属鞋眼，外侧还有一段短拉链；厚实的白色橡胶鞋底边缘带有竖向凹纹。

B07BNJ44VJ.en: This is a brown moccasin-style slip-on shoe with a suede-like upper and pale, fluffy lining visible at the opening. It has no fastener, and the brown rubber-like sole has a low profile with small ridges along the bottom.
B07BNJ44VJ.zh: 这是一只棕色莫卡辛式套脚鞋，鞋面看起来像绒面材质，鞋口露出浅色蓬松的内衬。鞋上没有扣合装置，棕色鞋底较薄，底部带有细小纹路。

B07BYS14XF.en: A black ballet flat with a rounded toe and a low-cut opening. The upper looks like suede or a suede-like material, with no visible fastening; a thin, flat black sole is visible along the bottom.
B07BYS14XF.zh: 这是一只黑色芭蕾平底鞋，鞋头圆润，鞋口较低。鞋面看起来像麂皮或类似麂皮的材质，没有可见的搭扣；底部可见一层薄而平的黑色鞋底。

B07BTF9G3X.en: A dark gray, open-toe slide sandal with two wide, textured straps across the foot. The straps appear to be molded material with a woven pattern and do not have a buckle or other fastening; the thick, dark sole has a textured edge.
B07BTF9G3X.zh: 这是一款深灰色露趾一字拖凉鞋，脚面有两条宽宽的纹理鞋带。鞋带看起来是带编织纹样的模压材质，没有搭扣或其他固定装置；厚实的深色鞋底边缘带有纹理。

B07BZGVBF7.en: A dusty rose flip-flop has a thong strap with a fabric-looking upper and stitched panels. It slips on with no buckle; the shoe has a pale footbed and a thick white sole with a dark gray tread underneath.
B07BZGVBF7.zh: 这是一只灰玫瑰色的人字拖，夹趾带和鞋面看起来像布料，并带有缝线拼接。它无需扣带，直接穿入；鞋床为浅色，厚白色鞋底下方可见深灰色纹路。

B07C1DL94B.en: A black Mary Jane-style walking shoe has a textured, knit-looking fabric upper and a wide strap across the instep that fastens at the side. It has a thick white sole with deep, rounded cutouts along the edge.
B07C1DL94B.zh: 这是一只黑色玛丽珍式步行鞋，鞋面呈纹理状，像针织织物；脚背处有一条宽鞋带，在侧面扣合。鞋底较厚，呈白色，边缘带有较深的圆形凹口。

B07BZZ33R6.en: A black thong sandal has a glossy, textured upper decorated with small brown and silver studs. It slips on, with a toe post and no buckle; the black sole is thick and slightly raised at the heel, with a textured tread underneath.
B07BZZ33R6.zh: 这是一只黑色夹趾凉鞋，鞋面带有光泽和纹理，并饰有棕色与银色小铆钉。凉鞋套脚穿着，以夹趾带固定，没有搭扣；黑色鞋底较厚，后跟略高，底面带有纹路。

B07C1Z3TKP.en: A low-top sneaker has a dark green fabric upper and white laces threaded through silver eyelets. It has a white rubber sole with a ridged edge.
B07C1Z3TKP.zh: 这是一只低帮运动鞋，深绿色布面鞋身配有穿过银色鞋眼的白色鞋带。白色橡胶鞋底边缘带有纹路。

B07C7DNT95.en: A dark brown slip-on loafer with a smooth, leather-like upper, tan stitching, and elastic side gussets. It has no laces or buckle, and a thick, rounded black sole with a textured edge.
B07C7DNT95.zh: 这是一只深棕色一脚蹬便鞋，鞋面光滑，外观像皮革，带有浅棕色缝线和两侧松紧鞋片。鞋上没有鞋带或搭扣，配有厚实圆润、边缘带纹理的黑色鞋底。

B07C2KSHC7.en: A gray, slip-on ballet flat has a rounded toe and a fabric-looking upper with a broad overlapping panel across the top. It has no visible fastening, and the thin, flat sole is gray.
B07C2KSHC7.zh: 这是一只灰色圆头平底芭蕾鞋，鞋面看起来像织物，顶部有一片宽大的交叠面料。鞋上没有可见的扣合装置，薄而平的鞋底也是灰色的。

B07C876KD2.en: A white athletic walking shoe with a smooth, leather-like upper and small perforated panels. It has white laces and a thick, sculpted white sole with dark sections at the toe and heel.
B07C876KD2.zh: 这是一只白色运动步行鞋，鞋面光滑，呈皮革质感，并带有小块透气孔区域。鞋带为白色，厚实的白色鞋底轮廓起伏，鞋头和后跟处有深色部分。

B07C1Z2JLC.en: This is a tan-brown moccasin-style slipper with a suede-like upper, a cream-and-brown plush lining, and a small bow across the front. It has a thick brown sole with ridged tread around the sides and bottom.
B07C1Z2JLC.zh: 这是一只棕褐色莫卡辛式拖鞋，鞋面看起来像麂皮，内衬为奶油色和棕色的绒毛，鞋头上方系着一条小蝴蝶结。鞋底较厚，棕色鞋底的侧边和底面带有凹凸纹路。

B07CBMMG6S.en: A dark charcoal-gray thong sandal has a braided strap across the top and a toe post, with no buckle or other visible fastener. Its upper looks like leather, and the sole is dark, flat, and slightly raised at the edge.
B07CBMMG6S.zh: 这是一只深炭灰色的人字拖凉鞋，鞋面有编织带和夹趾柱，没有可见的搭扣或其他固定装置。鞋面看起来像皮革，鞋底颜色较深、较平，边缘略厚。

B07CD5F6TM.en: A black athletic shoe with a synthetic-looking upper, stitched overlays, and two wide hook-and-loop straps across the front. It has a thick black sole with deep, jagged tread.
B07CD5F6TM.zh: 这是一只黑色运动鞋，鞋面看起来像合成材料，并带有缝线装饰层；前部有两条宽大的粘扣带。黑色鞋底较厚，带有深而不规则的纹路。

B07CJDBCCR.en: A dark brown slip-on loafer has a smooth, shiny leather-looking upper with stitched panels and no visible laces or buckle. It has a thick, black, ridged rubber-looking sole.
B07CJDBCCR.zh: 这是一只深棕色套穿式乐福鞋，鞋面看起来光滑有光泽，像皮革制成，并带有拼接缝线；看不到鞋带或搭扣。鞋底厚实、黑色，外观带有纹路，像橡胶材质。

B07CM39VKG.en: A black patent-look pump has a rounded toe, a teardrop cutout at the front, and a T-strap with a small buckle at the ankle. It has a mid-height heel and a light tan sole with a textured pattern.
B07CM39VKG.zh: 这是一款黑色漆皮外观的高跟鞋，圆头前部有水滴形镂空，T字鞋带在脚踝处以小扣环固定。鞋跟中等高度，浅棕色鞋底带有纹路。

B07CNC83PS.en: A white low-top sneaker has a layered upper with smooth and perforated panels, fabric laces, and a padded gray mesh collar. Its thick white rubber sole has sculpted ridges and raised oval details along the sides and bottom.
B07CNC83PS.zh: 这是一只白色低帮运动鞋，鞋面由光滑和带孔的分层面料拼接而成，配有布鞋带和灰色网布软垫鞋口。厚实的白色橡胶鞋底带有立体纹路，侧面和底部可见凸起的椭圆形细节。

B07CNTN21B.en: A light gray, low-cut water shoe has a breathable-looking knit upper, gray elastic laces, and a black toggle at the front. Its thick gray rubber sole has a raised, patterned tread with dark grip patches.
B07CNTN21B.zh: 这是一款浅灰色低帮涉水鞋，鞋面看起来是透气针织材质，配有灰色弹力鞋带和前端黑色扣件。厚实的灰色橡胶鞋底带有凸起纹路和深色防滑块。

B07CG2XTK9.en: A black slip-on garden shoe has a smooth-looking upper with a textured panel over the toe, plus a stretchy-looking collar edged in bright green. It has no visible laces or buckle, and the thick black sole has deep, irregular tread with a thin green stripe along the side.
B07CG2XTK9.zh: 这是一只黑色套穿式园艺鞋，鞋面看起来较光滑，鞋头处有一块带纹理的区域，弹性鞋口边缘饰有亮绿色。鞋面没有可见的鞋带或扣具；厚实的黑色鞋底带有深而不规则的纹路，侧边有一道细绿色条纹。

B07CMK6PYR.en: This is a low-cut water shoe with a purple, blue, and turquoise scale pattern on a fine, fabric-like upper, finished with black edging and a small heel loop. It has no visible fastening, and the sole appears thin and dark.
B07CMK6PYR.zh: 这是一款低帮水鞋，鞋面呈紫色、蓝色和青绿色的鳞片图案，外观看起来像细密织物，边缘为黑色，后跟有一个小拉环。看不到明显的扣合装置，鞋底看起来较薄且颜色较深。

B07CKS1ZWW.en: A black, closed-toe slipper with a thick, fuzzy-looking fabric upper and an oval opening edged in black. It has no visible fastening, and the sole is not visible from this top-down view.
B07CKS1ZWW.zh: 这是一只黑色包头拖鞋，鞋面看起来是厚实蓬松的织物，椭圆形开口边缘为黑色。看不到明显的固定扣，也看不到鞋底。
